title.en: US allies in Asia alarmed as think tank calls for pullback
title.zh: 亚洲盟友对智库呼吁撤军感到震惊

summary.en: Analysts warn that a US withdrawal from the western Pacific, as recently suggested by a think tank, would weaken deterrence and strengthen China's position. A report by Jennifer Kavanagh of the Defense Priorities Foundation advocates for the US to "narrow its defense commitments in the region" by ending mutual defense...
summary.zh: 分析人士警告称，正如一家智库最近建议的那样，美国从西太平洋撤军将削弱威慑力并加强中国的地位。珍妮弗·卡瓦纳（Jennifer Kavanagh）在偏右的国防优先基金会（Defense Priorities...

body.en:
Analysts warn that a US withdrawal from the western Pacific, as recently suggested by a think tank, would weaken deterrence and strengthen China's position.

A study by a US foreign policy think tank advocates a major military pullback from the western Pacific, prompting concern among long-standing allies of the United States across the Indo-Pacific, analysts say.

The report  was authored by Jennifer Kavanagh, a senior fellow and director of military analysis at the right-of-center Defense Priorities Foundation. Kavanagh calls for the US to "narrow its defense commitments in the region" by ending mutual defense alliances with South Korea , Japan , Australia and the Philippines .

The priority for Washington, she states, is to defend the US homeland and safeguard access to key economic markets and trade routes. That would be best served by pulling back from the "first island chain," which runs from Okinawa in southern Japan, through Taiwan and on to the Philippines.

Kavanagh writes that US forces should be pared back and moved to the "second island chain," which runs from eastern Japan to the Northern Marianas Islands in the central Pacific, Guam, Palau and on to Papua New Guinea.

The report states that moving the troops back would make their positions easier to defend and "reduce the risk of a catastrophic war with China."

Such a withdrawal would arguably be most keenly felt in Taiwan , which Beijing views as a renegade province that must one day be assimilated into greater China .

In her report, Kavanagh notes that the US has no formal commitment to come to the assistance of Taiwan in the event of an attack by China. She warns that any armed clash "would come at an exorbitant cost for the United States, far in excess of any benefits."

"With a cost-benefit calculation this lopsided, a change in the US commitment to Taiwan seems wise," she said. "The United States should shift from strategic ambiguity to a clear non-intervention policy in the event of any military confrontation over Taiwan."

The countries named in the report have made no formal comments on the think tank's proposals, but its conclusions "will be viewed with shock," William Yang, a Taiwan-based security analyst for the International Crisis Group, told DW.

The concern will be even deeper given that the Defense Priorities Foundation is known for its isolationist foreign and defense policy positions and is reputed to have ties with a number of senior and like-minded decision-makers in the White House, Yang said.

Yang noted that US President Donald Trump has repeatedly threatened to withdraw troops from allied nations in Europe and Asia if his demands for larger payments or concessions in some other area of the bilateral relationship were not met, Yang...
body.zh: 分析人士警告说，正如一家智库最近建议的那样，美国从西太平洋撤军将削弱威慑力并加强中国的地位。 分析人士称，美国外交政策智囊团的一项研究主张从西太平洋地区大规模撤军，这引起了美国在印太地区的长期盟友的担忧。 该报告的作者詹妮弗·卡瓦纳 (Jennifer Kavanagh) 是中右翼国防优先基金会的高级研究员兼军事分析主任。卡瓦纳呼吁美国终止与韩国、日本、澳大利亚和菲律宾的共同防御联盟，“缩小其在该地区的防务承诺”。 她表示，华盛顿的首要任务是保卫美国本土并保障进入主要经济市场和贸易路线的机会。最好的办法是从“第一岛链”撤军，该岛链从日本南部的冲绳岛，穿过台湾，一直延伸到菲律宾。 卡瓦纳写道，美军应该削减规模，并转移到“第二岛链”，该岛链从日本东部到太平洋中部的北马里亚纳群岛、关岛、帕劳，再到巴布亚新几内亚。 报告指出，撤军将使他们的阵地更容易保卫，并“减少与中国发生灾难性战争的风险”。 可以说，这种撤军对台湾的感受最为强烈，北京将台湾视为一个叛逆的省份，有一天必须被纳入大中华区。 卡瓦纳在报告中指出，美国没有正式承诺在台湾遭受中国袭击时向台湾提供援助。她警告说，任何武装冲突“都会给美国带来高昂的代价，远远超过任何好处”。 她说：“鉴于成本效益计算如此不平衡，美国改变对台湾的承诺似乎是明智的。” “如果台湾问题发生任何军事对抗，美国应该从战略模糊转向明确的不干预政策。” 国际危机组织驻台湾安全分析师杨威廉告诉德国之声，报告中点名的国家尚未对该智库的提议发表正式评论，但其结论“将会令人震惊”。 杨说，鉴于国防优先基金会以其孤立主义外交和国防政策立场而闻名，并且据称与白宫许多高级和志同道合的决策者有联系，这种担忧将会更加严重。 杨指出，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普多次威胁称，如果他在双边关系其他领域提出的更多付款或让步的要求得不到满足，他将从欧洲和亚洲盟国撤军。

reflection.en: A report from the Defense Priorities Foundation suggests a significant shift in US defense strategy, advocating for a pullback from the western Pacific and the termination of key alliances. This proposal, intended to re-evaluate commitments, has understandably alarmed long-standing allies who rely on these security arrangements. The situation underscores...
reflection.zh: 国防优先基金会的一份报告建议美国国防战略发生重大转变，主张从西太平洋撤军并终止关键联盟。这项旨在重新评估承诺的提议，可以理解地引起了那些依赖这些安全安排的长期盟友的警惕。这一局势凸显了在考虑影响全球稳定和信任的重大政策变革时，审慎权衡和明智咨询的至关重要性。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: China tightens travel rules over tech security
title.zh: 中国收紧旅行规定以保障科技安全

summary.en: Beijing has implemented new travel restrictions, including exit bans for individuals deemed to have endangered China's "industrial or technological security." These rules, particularly relevant to artificial intelligence and technology import/export violations, aim to protect national sovereignty, security, and...
summary.zh: 北京实施了新的旅行限制，包括对被认为危害中国“工业或技术安全”的个人实施出境禁令。这些规定尤其针对人工智能以及技术进出口违规行为，旨在保护国家主权、安全和发展利益，并可能影响外国及台湾国民。

body.en:
Beijing says the new rules, which could also apply to foreign and Taiwanese nationals, are aimed at safeguarding "national security."

Sweeping travel restrictions on Chinese citizens came into effect on Tuesday, including exit bans for people considered to have endangered China 's "industrial or technological security."

The new exit-and-entry rules, which were passed in July, apply to citizens deemed to have violated technology import and export regulations, particularly in the field of artificial intelligence .

The State Council in Beijing said the new rules were formulated to "safeguard national sovereignty, security, and development interests."

The regulations apply not only to people within China but also to Chinese citizens deemed to have committed criminal acts abroad.

In such cases, citizens could be "prohibited from leaving the country for a period of six months to three years from the date of their return to China," said the State Council.

The restrictions come as China remains locked in a technological arms race with the United States , with both countries accusing each other of stealing locally developed AI models in recent months.

And analysts warn that the full scope of the new rules will only become clear once they start being implemented.

Security and criminal activities "can be vaguely defined and easily adjusted," said Chong Ja Ian, an analyst from the National University of Singapore , telling the AFP news agency that Beijing has given itself a "wide remit."

Under the new regulations, foreign nationals could also be denied entry to China for up to five years if found to have made false statements in ​visa applications.

Foreign governments have often reported instances of citizens being denied permission to leave China due ⁠to security-related ​investigations.

Analyst Chong highlighted the recent case of US citizen Min Zin who the US government said was detained improperly in Yunnan province in June.

"The case of Min Zin is a reminder that the range of people [that Beijing] could restrict from exiting could be quite wide – and potentially arbitrary," he said.

The new rules could have particular implications for Taiwanese nationals who work in the tech sector and who travel between Taiwan and China .

Authorities in Taipei have warned citizens to take extra care on visits to China, which considers people from Taiwan to be Chinese citizens.

Beijing has dismissed any such concerns, claiming the rules provide better legal protection for Taiwanese.

Dylan Loh, an associate professor at Singapore's Nanyang Technological University, told AFP the travel restrictions "send a message" that China will take action to prevent "leaks in security or national interest-sensitive areas."

If you rely on our team for trusted...
body.zh: 北京表示，新规定也可能适用于外国人和台湾公民，旨在维护“国家安全”。 对中国公民的全面旅行限制于周二生效，包括对被认为危及中国“工业或技术安全”的人实施出境禁令。 7月份通过的新出入境规定适用于被视为违反技术进出口规定的公民，特别是在人工智能领域。 北京国务院表示，制定新规定是为了“维护国家主权、安全、发展利益”。 该规定不仅适用于中国境内的人，也适用于被认为在国外有犯罪行为的中国公民。 国务院表示，在这种情况下，公民可能“自返回中国之日起六个月至三年内禁止出境”。 这些限制出台之际，中国仍陷入与美国的技术军备竞赛，近几个月来两国互相指责对方窃取当地开发的人工智能模型。 分析人士警告说，新规则的全部范围只有在开始实施后才会变得清晰。 新加坡国立大学分析师庄嘉伊恩 (Chong Ja Ian) 告诉法新社，安全和犯罪活动“可以被模糊地定义，并且很容易调整”。他告诉法新社，北京方面已经赋予了自己“广泛的职权范围”。 根据新规定，如果发现在签证申请中提供虚假陈述，外国人也可能被拒绝进入中国，最长可达五年。 外国政府经常报告公民因安全相关调查而被拒绝离开中国的情况。 分析师 Chong 重点介绍了最近发生的美国公民敏津的案件，美国政府称其于 6 月在云南省被不当拘留。 “敏津的案例提醒我们，（北京）可以限制退出的人群范围可能相当广泛，而且可能是任意的，”他说。 新规定可能对在科技行业工作以及在台湾和中国大陆之间旅行的台湾国民产生特别影响。 台北当局警告公民前往中国大陆时要格外小心，中国将台湾人视为中国公民。 北京方面否认了任何此类担忧，声称这些规则为台湾人提供了更好的法律保护。 新加坡南洋理工大学副教授迪伦·卢告诉法新社，旅行限制“发出了一个信息”，即中国将采取行动防止“安全或国家利益敏感领域的泄密”。 如果您信赖我们的团队值得信赖...

reflection.en: The implementation of sweeping travel restrictions and exit bans in China, justified under the banner of national security, raises concerns about the potential for unchecked state power. Proverbs 28:15 warns that "when the wicked rule, people groan," highlighting the human cost when security measures become oppressive.
reflection.zh: 中国以国家安全为由实施广泛的旅行限制和出境禁令，这引发了对国家权力不受制约的担忧。《箴言》28章15节警告说：“恶人掌权，人民就叹息。”这句经文强调了当安全措施变得压迫性时，所带来的巨大的人类代价。

verse.textEn: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.
verse.textZh: 暴虐的君王辖制贫民，好像吼叫的狮子、觅食的熊。

title.en: ‘This is seriously bold’: How China turned Taiwan tensions into a top-rating TV spy drama
title.zh: “这真是大胆”：中国如何将台湾紧张局势变成一部收视率飙升的电视间谍剧

summary.en: A new Chinese spy drama, 'Long Watch' (Jiaofeng), co-produced by the Ministry of State Security, has become a hit across the Taiwan Strait. The show, which fictionalizes real-life crises, follows a double agent working for China whose cover is blown. While dismissed as propaganda in Taiwan, the series' success...
summary.zh: 一部由国家安全部联合制作的中国新间谍剧《交锋》（Jiaofeng）已成为海峡两岸的热门剧集。该剧将现实生活中的危机虚构化，讲述了一名在中国大陆秘密工作的双面间谍被揭穿的故事。尽管在台湾被斥为宣传片，但该剧的成功凸显了娱乐媒体在处理敏感政治话题方面的作用。

body.en: Dismissed in Taiwan as simply propaganda, the Long Watch, or Jiaofeng, has proved a sensation across the strait with its references to real-life crises After shaking off the people trailing her through a crowded market and emerging from a bathroom in disguise, the double agent appears to have escaped. But a sip of water on a plane eventually gets her. She is poisoned after Taiwan’s military intelligence service discovers that she has been working secretly for China. The plot comes from a new Chinese spy drama co-produced by the Ministry of State Security. Since its premiere on 6 September, it has become a TV hit, with a fictionalised take on a subject rarely treated so directly: the modern history of tensions with Taiwan. Continue reading...
body.zh: 在台湾，《长守》或《叫风》被认为只是宣传品，但它却因提及现实生活中的危机而轰动了海峡两岸。在摆脱了跟踪她的人穿过拥挤的市场，乔装打扮地从浴室里出来后，这位双重间谍似乎已经逃脱了。但飞机上的一小口水最终让她崩溃了。台湾军事情报部门发现她一直在为中国大陆秘密工作后，她被毒死。剧情来自于国家安全部联合制作的一部新的中国谍战剧。自 9 月 6 日首播以来，它已成为电视热门节目，以虚构的方式讲述了一个很少如此直接处理的主题：与台湾紧张关系的现代历史。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This drama, 'Long Watch,' produced with the involvement of China's Ministry of State Security, uses fictionalized events to explore cross-strait tensions. It raises questions about how narratives are shaped and disseminated through popular media, reminding us of the importance of discerning truth from fiction, as Ephesians 4:25 urges us to speak truthfully...
reflection.zh: 这部由中国国家安全部参与制作的《交锋》剧集，通过虚构的情节来探讨海峡两岸的紧张局势。它引发了关于叙事如何通过大众媒体塑造和传播的疑问，提醒我们要分辨真伪，正如以弗所书4章25节所劝勉的，要说诚实话。

verse.textEn: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to your neighbor.
verse.textZh: 所以你们要弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说实话。

title.en: China dismisses AI ‘fearmongering’ as spy chief warns of threat to Communist party rule
title.zh: 中国驳斥人工智能‘危言耸听’，因间谍头子警告其威胁执政党统治

summary.en: Beijing has responded to calls for the US to hinder China's AI industry, dismissing them as 'fearmongering.' This comes as China's top spy chief expressed concerns that the advancement of artificial intelligence could pose a threat to the rule of the Communist party.
summary.zh: 北京方面驳斥了要求美国阻碍中国人工智能产业发展的呼吁，称其为‘危言耸听’。与此同时，中国最高情报官员警告称，人工智能的不断发展可能威胁到共产党统治。

body.en: Beijing hits back after Anthropic CEO calls for US to impede China’s progress in AI China has dismissed what it said were “fearmongering” calls for the US to block Beijing’s AI industry, even as the top Chinese spy chief warned the evolving technology could threaten Communist party rule. The US tech entrepreneur and Anthropic chief executive, Dario Amodei, wrote an essay published over the weekend that called for a global slowdown in AI capabilities, but also said Washington should actively impede Beijing’s advancement in order to keep a technological edge. Continue reading...
body.zh: Anthropic首席执行官呼吁美国阻止中国在人工智能领域取得进展，北京对此进行了反击。尽管中国最高间谍头子警告说，不断发展的技术可能会威胁共产党的统治，但中国驳回了所谓美国封锁北京人工智能产业的“恐吓”呼吁。美国科技企业家兼 Anthropic 首席执行官达里奥·阿莫迪 (Dario Amodei) 在周末发表了一篇文章，呼吁全球人工智能能力放缓，但也表示华盛顿应积极阻碍北京的进步，以保持技术优势。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence presents humanity with unprecedented capabilities, prompting both excitement and apprehension. As nations and leaders grapple with its potential, the ancient story of Babel reminds us that unchecked ambition, even in pursuit of knowledge or power, can lead to unintended consequences and division.
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展为人类带来了前所未有的能力，既引发了兴奋，也带来了忧虑。当国家和领导人都在努力应对其潜力时，古老的巴别塔故事提醒我们，即使是在追求知识或权力的过程中，不受约束的野心也可能导致意想不到的后果和分裂。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: Why North Korea's Kim Jong Un doesn't need a US deal
title.zh: 朝鲜的金正恩为何不需要与美国达成协议

summary.en: Donald Trump's overtures to North Korea's dictator have gone nowhere, with an emboldened Pyongyang accelerating its nuclear program and solidifying alliances with Russia and China.
summary.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普对朝鲜独裁者的示好毫无进展，平壤在得到鼓舞后正在加速其核计划，并巩固与俄罗斯和中国的联盟。

body.en:
Donald Trump's overtures to North Korea's dictator have gone nowhere, with an emboldened Pyongyang accelerating its nuclear program and solidifying alliances with Russia and China.

In August, US President Donald Trump revived a charm offensive aimed at Pyongyang by drastically scaling back joint US military exercises with South Korea and heaping praise on North Korean leader Kim Jong Un. The US president said the North Korean dictator "has always treated me with great respect."

North Korea's response to Trump's overtures has been markedly less enthusiastic, ranging from firing a barrage of missiles to publicly denying Trump's claims that Kim has responded "very positively" to a request for talks.

This week, as the US and South Korea, along with Japan, kicked off a five-day military drill, there was no mention of any pullback from Washington, nor any sign of diplomatic progress with Pyongyang.

Instead, Kim on Monday commissioned a naval destroyer, while again emphasizing North Korea must establish a "powerful and reliable nuclear war deterrent" and strengthen "maritime defense." Kim also said North Korea would soon unveil a "significant" naval advancement.

Unlike the summit diplomacy of Trump's first term, Kim's dismissive stance comes at a time when North Korea has alternatives to a grand bargain with the United States.

"For Kim, the stakes are simply lower than they were in 2019. There is no longer the same sense of urgency in Pyongyang to get back to the negotiating table with Washington," Joon Ha Park, a correspondent at Korea Risk Group in Seoul, told DW.

"North Korea now has a treaty-based alliance with Moscow and is drawing closer to Beijing, while its military capabilities have expanded significantly. That's why a single reduction in ROK-US military exercises is not enough for Pyongyang to be swayed," he added, referring to military ties between South Korea and the US.

Park agrees that Kim is arguably in his strongest position since taking power in 2011. Just six years ago, amid crippling sanctions and the coronavirus pandemic, an emotional Kim stood at the lectern marking the 75th anniversary of the Korean Workers' Party and expressed regret for having failed the North Korean people.

Fast forward to today, and North Korea's economy appears to be on a stronger footing . Estimates released last year by South Korea's central bank showed the economy expanded by 3.7% in 2024, its fastest rate of growth in eight years.

Kim has brought North Korea closer to Russia and China than the traditionally isolated country has been in decades. This week, both Moscow and Beijing sent messages marking North Korea's 78th founding anniversary and praising the strategic importance of their deepening partnerships with...
body.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普对朝鲜独裁者的示好毫无进展，胆大妄为的平壤加速了核计划，并巩固了与俄罗斯和中国的联盟。 上个月，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普大幅缩减美国与韩国的联合军演，并对朝鲜领导人金正恩大加赞扬，从而重新发起针对平壤的魅力攻势。美国总统表示，朝鲜独裁者“一直非常尊重我”。 朝鲜对特朗普提议的反应明显不那么热情，从发射一连串导弹到公开否认特朗普关于金正恩对会谈请求做出“非常积极”回应的说法。 本周，美国、韩国以及日本开始了为期五天的军事演习，但没有提到华盛顿有任何撤军，也没有任何与平壤取得外交进展的迹象。 相反，金正恩周一委托了一艘海军驱逐舰，同时再次强调朝鲜必须建立“强大而可靠的核战争威慑力量”并加强“海上防御”。金正恩还表示，朝鲜很快将公布一项“重大”海军进展。 与特朗普第一任期的峰会外交不同，金正恩的不屑一顾的立场是在朝鲜除了与美国达成大交易之外还有其他选择之际采取的。 “对金正恩来说，赌注比2019年要低。平壤不再有回到与华盛顿谈判桌的紧迫感，”首尔韩国风险集团记者Joon Ha Park告诉德国之声。 “朝鲜现在与莫斯科建立了基于条约的联盟，并且正在向北京靠拢，而其军事能力也显着增强。这就是为什么韩美军事演习的一次减少不足以让平壤动摇，”他在谈到韩国和美国之间的军事关系时补充道。 朴槿惠也同意，金正恩可以说是自 2011 年上台以来处于最有利的位置。 就在六年前，在严厉的制裁和冠状病毒大流行的背景下，金正恩情绪激动地站在纪念朝鲜劳动党成立75周年的讲台上，对辜负了朝鲜人民的期望表示遗憾。 快进到今天，朝鲜经济似乎已经站稳了脚跟。韩国央行去年发布的预测显示，2024年经济将增长3.7%，为八年来最快增速。 金正恩使朝鲜与俄罗斯和中国的关系比这个传统上孤立的国家几十年来更加接近。本周，莫斯科和北京都发出了纪念朝鲜成立 78 周年的信息，并赞扬了两国深化与朝鲜的伙伴关系的战略重要性……

reflection.en: The news highlights how Kim Jong Un's regime continues to advance its nuclear ambitions, seemingly unfazed by diplomatic overtures. Proverbs 28:15 warns that 'When the wicked rule, people groan.' This verse speaks to the inherent instability and suffering that can arise when power is wielded without accountability, as seen in the continued acceleration of...
reflection.zh: 新闻指出，金正恩政权似乎并未受到外交示好的影响，仍在推进其核野心。箴言 28:15 警告说：“恶人在位，人就叹息。”这节经文呼应了当权力在缺乏问责的情况下被滥用时，可能产生的固有不稳定和苦难，正如在国际关注下朝鲜核计划的持续加速所见。

verse.textEn: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.
verse.textZh: 暴虐的君王辖制贫民，好像吼叫的狮子、觅食的熊。

title.en: Call in China to end English's core status sparks debate
title.zh: 中国呼吁结束英语核心地位引发辩论

summary.en: A call to downgrade English in Chinese schools is fueling discussion over its value for students, careers, and China's global competitiveness in the age of AI.
summary.zh: 在中国学校降低英语地位的呼吁正在引发关于其对学生、职业以及人工智能时代中国全球竞争力的价值的讨论。

body.en:
A call to downgrade English in Chinese schools is fueling discussion over its value for students, careers and China's global competitiveness in the age of AI.

From business and academia to social media and entertainment — English is considered the dominant global language. One in five people on Earth actively uses this lingua franca. In China , a mathematics professor specializing in vector algebra is now challenging this dominance in no uncertain terms. Tang Jiafeng believes that English should be abolished as a core subject in elementary schools, secondary schools and universities.

Tang is convinced that no other country in the world has placed as much importance on English as China has.

"Our children desperately begin learning English even before they have properly mastered their native language. Yet we are a civilization that dates back thousands of years. English is just a tool. It's enough to be able to use it. The tradition of revering and emulating Western cultures must come to an end," Tang says in social media.

English is considered difficult in China, since the Chinese language does not use an alphabetic script. It is a required subject starting in third grade. It is graded on par with Chinese and mathematics on the entrance exam for secondary schools, the central exam after 9th grade, and the high school graduation exam. A maximum of 150 points can be earned on the latter.

"How many resources and how much time do our children, parents and schools invest in a subject that is completely irrelevant to the majority of people in their future professional lives?" the mathematician asks, explaining his position.

He became well-known because many of his students achieved full scores on state math exams; in the class of 2011, six students from a single class did so.

"Why cram for English when artificial intelligence can translate everything in seconds?" comments a user from Beijing.

Another suggestion from the southern province of Guangdong is to at least adjust the scoring — for example, to 120 points instead of 150 on the high school graduation exam.

Many parents invest in private tutoring that focuses specifically on exam questions. In addition, all bachelor's students must pass the English exam before being admitted to master's programs. Tang suspects that this could cause many young talents in the natural sciences to fail, even though they have great potential to become top researchers.

There is no question that English is also important for STEM subjects. Research on future-oriented topics is typically published in English. There are fears circulating online that cutting back on English instruction could lead to a decline in China's competitiveness. A prominent advocate for English as a required subject is Hu Xijin,...
body.zh: 降低中国学校英语等级的呼声引发了关于人工智能时代英语对学生、职业和中国全球竞争力价值的讨论。 从商业和学术界到社交媒体和娱乐——英语被认为是全球主导语言。地球上五分之一的人积极使用这种通用语言。在中国，一位专门研究向量代数的数学教授现在正在毫不含糊地挑战这一主导地位。唐家峰认为，应该取消英语作为小学、中学和大学的核心科目。 唐坚信，世界上没有哪个国家像中国一样重视英语。 唐在社交媒体上表示：“我们的孩子在还没有真正掌握母语之前就拼命地开始学习英语。但我们是一个有着数千年历史的文明。英语只是一种工具，能够使用它就足够了。尊重和效仿西方文化的传统必须结束。” 英语在中国被认为很难，因为中文不使用字母文字。这是从三年级开始的必修科目。中学入学考试、九年级后的集中考试和高中毕业考试的成绩与语文和数学同等。后者最多可获得 150 点积分。 “我们的孩子、家长和学校在一个与大多数人未来职业生涯完全无关的主题上投入了多少资源和时间？”数学家问道，并解释了他的立场。 他之所以出名，是因为他的许多学生在州数学考试中取得了满分。 2011届的一个班有六名学生这样做了。 “当人工智能可以在几秒钟内翻译所有内容时，为什么还要死记硬背英语呢？”北京网友评论。 来自南方省份广东省的另一项建议是至少调整分数——例如，高中毕业考试的分数从150分调整为120分。 许多家长投资专门针对考试问题的私人辅导。此外，所有学士学生必须通过英语考试才能进入硕士课程。唐怀疑这可能会导致许多自然科学领域的年轻人才失败，尽管他们有成为顶尖研究人员的巨大潜力。 毫无疑问，英语对于 STEM 科目也很重要。面向未来的主题的研究通常以英文发表。网上流传着这样的担忧：削减英语教学可能会导致中国竞争力下降。将英语作为必修科目的一位著名倡导者是胡锡进……

reflection.en: The debate in China about the role of English in education touches on how societies navigate the explosion of knowledge and global communication. As Professor Tang Jiafeng questions English's dominance, it mirrors the broader challenge of discerning which knowledge serves us best in an era of unprecedented information growth, as described in Daniel 12:4:...
reflection.zh: 在中国关于英语教育作用的辩论，触及了社会如何应对知识的爆炸式增长和全球交流。正如唐嘉风教授质疑英语的主导地位，这也反映了一个更广泛的挑战：在一个信息空前增长的时代，辨别哪些知识最能服务于我们。正如但以理书12:4所描述的：“必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。”

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Australia Desk
title.zh: 澳洲栏目

title.zh: 澳大利亚政治直播：工党表示有子女抚养费债务的人将被禁止离开澳大利亚；伯克将公布新的移民规则

summary.en: The Australian Labor party is reportedly planning to prevent individuals with outstanding child support debts from leaving the country. This policy, along with other immigration rule changes, has drawn criticism from opposition figures who liken the proposals to those of the One Nation party. The Minister for...
summary.zh: 澳大利亚工党据称计划阻止有未偿子女抚养费债务的个人离境。这项政策以及其他移民规则的变动，招致了反对派人士的批评，他们将这些提议与一国党的主张相提并论。移民部长安德鲁·吉尔斯原定公布新的移民规则，但反对派人士讽刺地指出了他最后一刻取消新闻发布会一事。

body.en: Follow the day’s news live Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Barnaby Joyce says Labor is copying and pasting One Nation’s homework because the measures we know so far around blocking the families of international students and preventing visa hopping have some similarity to what Pauline Hanson is suggesting. Speaking to the Today show a little earlier, Joyce says Burke’s last minute cancellation at the press club was “the greatest no-show since Amelia Earhart”. He [Burke] can’t possibly be about to announce One Nation’s policy. I mean, Tony – Tony’s a great guy, right? I like Tony, but honestly, he was the greatest no-show since Amelia Earhart when he didn’t turn up to the Press Club … What I’ve heard thus far is that it’s an exact replication, but not to the extent of what One Nation is doing. I will be watching this with absolute fascination and some trepidation, and I’ll be waiting for Jim Chalmers to explain his new budget. I was on polling booths with my colleagues like Sally Sitou . I was out there in Reid with her in those last weeks of the campaign, standing there for hours at a time. She would be surrounded by men a foot taller than her, stopping her physically talking to or giving information to voters. I would think secretly paying known rightwing figures to disrupt events and pretend that they are just disgruntled citizens having their say is certainly immoral, if it’s not illegal. Continue reading...

While ensuring families receive support is crucial, the measures raise questions about fairness and potential unintended consequences. Micah 6:8 calls us to act justly, love...
reflection.zh: 澳大利亚拟议的阻止有子女抚养费债务者离境的政策，凸显了在强制承担经济责任与展现同情心之间的张力。虽然确保家庭获得支持至关重要，但这些措施引发了关于公平性和潜在意外后果的疑问。弥迦书6:8呼吁我们行公义、好怜悯、存谦卑的心与我们的神同行，提醒我们在政策中寻求兼顾问责与仁慈的平衡。

verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Morning Mail: AI tipping point warning; concerns about aged care scheme; and a US rate hike
title.zh: 人工智能的临界点警告；对老年护理计划的担忧；以及美国加息

summary.en: The news summary touches on several topics: a warning from a co-founder of AI technology about approaching a critical inflection point requiring government action, concerns about an algorithm used in aged care packages, and an increase in US interest rates.
summary.zh: 新闻摘要涉及多个主题：人工智能技术联合创始人发出警告，称正接近一个需要政府采取行动的关键转折点；对用于老年护理计划的算法的担忧；以及美国利率的上升。

body.en: Want to get this in your inbox every weekday? Sign up for the Morning Mail here , and finish your day with our Politics, really newsletter . Morning everyone. One of the godfathers of AI technology has warned that we are fast-approaching a Covid-style inflection point where governments have to act to protect the public. We also report on JD Vance shrugging off calls for regulation and have an explainer on what proposals to allow an AI scrape of Australian content means. Federal health officials were left in turmoil by an algorithm to determine aged care packages, Guardian analysis reveals how the grants program massively favoured Labor, US rates go up for the first time since 2023, and what’s behind the explosion in new Asian fast-food chains? Granted | Federal Labor seats have received more than 90% of funds already awarded in the first five months of a controversial multimillion-dollar grants program, Guardian Australia analysis reveals , adding to concerns over the scheme’s selection process. Aged care turmoil | Federal health officials were in turmoil before the rollout of an algorithm to determine funding packages for older Australians after discovering legislation had been drafted so rigidly that the tool could not legally be overridden by aged care assessors. Land fear | Local Aboriginal land councils in New South Wales say they remain deeply concerned about changes to laws governing crown land that could retrospectively affect land claims. Migration shift | Foreign students are set to face tough restrictions on the ability to bring family members into Australia as the home affairs minister, Tony Burke, prepares to outline the government’s immigration reforms at the National Press Club in Canberra today. Emergency measure | A new institute dedicated to improving emergency medical care for severely injured children will be established in New South Wales after recent high-profile trauma events in the state. Continue reading...

reflection.en: The rapid development of artificial intelligence, as highlighted in this story, brings both promise and peril. It echoes the ancient prophecy that in the final days, 'knowledge shall increase.' As we stand at this technological inflection point, the challenge is to pursue this growing knowledge with wisdom and ethical consideration, ensuring it serves...
reflection.zh: 正如本故事所强调的，人工智能的快速发展既带来了希望也带来了危险。它呼应了古老的预言，即在末日“知识必增长”。当我们站在这个技术转折点时，挑战在于以智慧和道德考量来追求日益增长的知识，确保它服务于人类而非损害人类。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: 'Mobilisation of fear': The deeper strategy behind One Nation's immigration policy
title.zh: “恐惧动员”：一国党移民政策背后的深层策略

summary.en: For temporary migrants, the rise of One Nation is raising an urgent question: how secure is their future? Jyoti, a teacher who has lived in Australia for nearly a decade, is anxiously awaiting an update on her visa application, a process that has become more urgent amid heightened political rhetoric surrounding...
summary.zh: 对于临时移民来说，一国党（One Nation）的崛起提出了一个紧迫的问题：他们的未来有多稳定？来自印度旁遮普的Jyoti是一位在澳大利亚居住了近十年的中学教师，她正焦急地等待着她的签证申请更新，而围绕移民的政治言论日益激烈，使得这一过程变得更加紧迫。

body.en:
Share your feedback and help us improve this feature. Read more about how we use AI at SBS here.

Jyoti has called her migration agent three times this month. Each time, she asks the same question: Has there been any update?

Her application for a Skilled Independent visa, a pathway to permanent residency , has been sitting in the queue for months. It has felt like a long wait for Jyoti, who has lived in Australia for the better part of a decade. In recent months, that uncertainty has taken on a new urgency.

The 43-year-old is a secondary school teacher who lives in an outer northern suburb of Melbourne with her husband and their two children. She arrived from Punjab, northern India, eight years ago as an international student and is now in Australia on a work visa.

She asks that only her first name be used because she fears speaking publicly could affect her family's visa prospects.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"International students, temporary visa holders ... we would be the first to lose our livelihoods and our place here if Pauline Hanson comes to power, or if her party keeps gaining momentum," she tells SBS News.

Jyoti says she is watching the lead-up to Victoria's November election closely. To her, the election will be an early test of how far One Nation leader Pauline Hanson's momentum could travel and what that could mean for her family's future in the only country her children have really known. It's a fear, she says, that everyone she knows in her position is carrying right now.

One Nation wants to cut 750,000 temporary visa holders from Australia over three years. Not one of them will get a say in whether the party succeeds.

"Our fate is being decided by political parties whose fate we have no say in," Jyoti says.

Australia is home to roughly three million temporary visa holders, including students, graduates and skilled workers.

As One Nation pushes for sweeping cuts to temporary migration, it raises a harder question about political power: are people with the least ability to influence an election also the easiest to target?

One Nation's plan would tighten the student and graduate visa systems, restrict family members from accompanying temporary skilled workers, and close off "visa hopping" — the practice of extending a stay by switching between visa categories rather than leaving the country and reapplying offshore.

According to the policy announced on Monday, international students and graduates would absorb the biggest cuts.

The student visa population, including accompanying family members, would fall from about 590,000 to 350,000, and the graduate visa population from about 270,000 to just 40,000 over...
body.zh: 分享您的反馈并帮助我们改进此功能。请在此处详细了解我们如何在 SBS 使用人工智能。 乔蒂本月已给她的移民代理打了三次电话。每次她都会问同样的问题：有更新吗？ 她申请独立技术签证（这是获得永久居留权的途径）的申请已经排队数月了。对于乔蒂来说，这感觉像是一场漫长的等待，他已经在澳大利亚生活了十年的大部分时间。近几个月来，这种不确定性变得更加紧迫。 43岁的她是一名中学教师，与丈夫和两个孩子住在墨尔本北郊外。八年前，她作为一名国际学生从印度北部的旁遮普邦来到澳大利亚，现在持工作签证来到澳大利亚。 她要求只使用她的名字，因为她担心公开发言可能会影响她家人的签证前景。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 她告诉 SBS 新闻：“如果波琳·汉森上台，或者她的政党继续势头强劲，国际学生、临时签证持有者……我们将是第一个失去生计和地位的人。” 乔蒂表示，她正在密切关注维多利亚十一月选举的准备情况。对她来说，这次选举将是一次早期考验，考验一国党领导人宝琳·汉森(Pauline Hanson)的势头能走多远，以及这对她的家人在她的孩子们唯一真正了解的国家的未来意味着什么。她说，她认识的每个处于她这个位置的人现在都在承受这种恐惧。 一国党希望在三年内削减 75 万名澳大利亚临时签证持有者。他们中没有人对政党是否成功有发言权。 乔蒂说：“我们的命运是由政党决定的，我们对这些政党的命运没有发言权。” 澳大利亚拥有大约三百万临时签证持有者，其中包括学生、毕业生和技术工人。 随着一国党推动全面削减临时移民，它提出了一个关于政治权力的更严峻的问题：影响选举的能力最弱的人是否也是最容易成为目标的人？ 一国党的计划将收紧学生和研究生签证制度，限制家庭成员陪同临时技术工人，并禁止“签证跳跃”——通过在签证类别之间切换而不是离开该国并在海外重新申请来延长停留时间的做法。 根据周一宣布的政策，国际学生和毕业生将吸收最大的削减。 包括随行家庭成员在内的学生签证人数将从约 590,000 人减少至 350,000 人，毕业生签证人数将从约 270,000 人减少至仅 40,000 人。

reflection.en: Jyoti's anxiety over her visa application reflects the precariousness faced by many temporary migrants in Australia. The political discourse, described as a 'mobilisation of fear,' can create deep insecurity for those seeking a stable future. Scripture calls us to welcome the foreigner, remembering our own sojourn in Egypt, and to treat them with justice...
reflection.zh: Jyoti对她的签证申请的焦虑反映了澳大利亚许多临时移民所面临的不确定性。被描述为“恐惧动员”的政治言论，可能给那些寻求稳定未来的人带来深刻的不安全感。经文呼吁我们欢迎外国人，要记得我们自己曾在埃及寄居，并要像对待本地人一样，以公正和怜悯对待他们。

verse.textEn: And you are to love those who are foreigners, for you yourselves were foreigners in Egypt.
verse.textZh: 所以你们要怜爱寄居的，因为你们在埃及地也作过寄居的。

title.en: An ancient disease is surging in Australia — and it isn't always easy to detect
title.zh: 澳大利亚一种古老疾病正在激增——而且并非总是容易检测到

summary.en: Diagnoses for some STIs have increased over the past decade with experts suggesting solutions may be already known.
summary.zh: 在过去十年中，一些性传播感染的诊断有所增加，专家们认为解决方案可能已经为人所知。

body.en:
Reported cases of infectious syphilis and gonorrhoea have surged by more than half over the past decade in Australia, as experts warn education and testing urgently needs to improve.

In 2025, there were 42,393 gonorrhoea notifications and 5,986 infectious syphilis notifications — a 10-year increase of 57 per cent for gonorrhoea and 56 per cent for syphilis, analysis from the University of New South Wales' Kirby Institute has shown.

Syphilis was declared a communicable disease of national significance in late 2025, in response to "ongoing and concerning" rises in Australian case numbers.

Chief medical officer Professor Michael Kidd declared that awareness was necessary among all Australians, including healthcare professionals, and urged everyone to get tested.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Syphilis and gonorrhoea are common bacterial infections with ancient origins, now easily treated with antibiotics.

If left untreated, syphilis progresses through stages and can spread to the brain, heart, eyes, and other organs. It can cause neurological problems including paralysis, and dementia, and cause soft, tumour-like growths to appear on the skin, bones or internal organs. Tertiary syphilis can eventually lead to death.

Notification rates for infectious syphilis among women increased 170 per cent in the past decade from 2016 to 2025. In contrast, rates increased just 39 per cent among males.

Syphilis during pregnancy can lead to congenital syphilis, which can result in miscarriage or stillbirth, or severe lifelong health impacts in babies that are born, including prematurity, low birthweight and other physical developmental abnormalities.

Kirby Institute epidemiologist Dr Skye McGregor said congenital syphilis is a persistent issue in Australia, with more than half of deaths in the last decade among First Nations infants. There were 14 cases of congenital syphilis in 2025, and 113 from 2016 to 2025, with 40 resulting in the death of an infant.

"This is an entirely preventable outcome with early diagnosis, testing and treatment of pregnant people," McGregor said.

First Nations peoples were disproportionately affected by STIs, diagnosed with gonorrhoea at more than four times the rate of non-Indigenous people and syphilis at more than six times.

Kim Gates, community relations lead in the Kirby Institute's First Nations Point-Of-Care Program, said the disparities in diagnoses between First Nations and non-Indigenous Australians were an indication of broader inequities in healthcare.

Australian services needed to be designed better to reflect the experiences of First Nations communities, Gates told SBS News, adding that many First...
body.zh: 过去十年来，澳大利亚报告的传染性梅毒和淋病病例激增了一半以上，专家警告说，教育和检测亟待改善。 新南威尔士大学柯比研究所的分析显示，2025 年，共收到 42,393 份淋病通报和 5,986 份传染性梅毒通报——淋病病例比 10 年来增加了 57%，梅毒病例增加了 56%。 2025 年底，为了应对澳大利亚病例数“持续且令人担忧”的上升，梅毒被宣布为全国性传染病。 首席医疗官迈克尔·基德教授宣称，包括医疗保健专业人员在内的所有澳大利亚人都有必要提高认识，并敦促每个人都接受检测。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 梅毒和淋病是常见的细菌感染，其起源古老，现在很容易用抗生素治疗。 如果不及时治疗，梅毒会分阶段发展，并可能扩散到大脑、心脏、眼睛和其他器官。它会导致神经系统问题，包括瘫痪和痴呆，并导致皮肤、骨骼或内脏器官上出现柔软的肿瘤样生长。三期梅毒最终可导致死亡。 从 2016 年到 2025 年的过去 10 年里，女性传染性梅毒的通报率增加了 170%。相比之下，男性的通报率仅增加了 39%。 怀孕期间感染梅毒可导致先天性梅毒，从而导致流产或死产，或对出生的婴儿造成严重的终生健康影响，包括早产、低出生体重和其他身体发育异常。 柯比研究所流行病学家斯凯·麦格雷戈博士表示，先天性梅毒是澳大利亚的一个长期存在的问题，过去十年中超过一半的死亡病例是原住民婴儿。 2025年有14例先天性梅毒病例，2016年至2025年有113例，其中40例导致婴儿死亡。 麦格雷戈说：“通过对孕妇进行早期诊断、检测和治疗，这是完全可以预防的结果。” 原住民受到性传播感染的影响尤为严重，被诊断出淋病的比例是非原住民的四倍多，梅毒的比例是非原住民的六倍多。 柯比研究所原住民护理点项目社区关系负责人金·盖茨表示，原住民和非原住民澳大利亚人之间的诊断差异表明医疗保健领域存在更广泛的不平等。 盖茨告诉 SBS 新闻，澳大利亚的服务需要更好地设计，以反映原住民社区的经验，并补充说许多原住民……

reflection.en: The rise in infectious syphilis and gonorrhea in Australia, increasing by over 50% in a decade, points to a significant public health challenge. This surge underscores the importance of proactive measures and community awareness in combating widespread illness, reminding us of the biblical call to care for the sick and address the root causes of disease.
reflection.zh: 澳大利亚传染性梅毒和淋病的发病率在十年内增加了50%以上，这表明公共卫生面临严峻挑战。这一激增凸显了在抗击广泛疾病方面采取积极措施和提高社区意识的重要性，提醒我们圣经中关怀病患、解决疾病根源的呼召。

verse.textEn: Is anyone among you sick? Let them call the elders of the church to pray over them.
verse.textZh: 你们中间有病了的呢，他就该请教会的长老来；他们可以奉主的名用油抹他，为他祷告。

The principle of acting justly calls for transparency and impartiality in all governmental dealings, ensuring that resources serve the broader...

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.

This spirit of advocacy, whether through music or activism, reflects a deep commitment to ensuring that all people are heard and valued.
reflection.zh: 亚当·布里格斯的新音乐项目“Big Noter”被誉为赋予无声者以声音，这有力地呼应了古老的呼召——为那些无法为自己发声的人挺身而出。这种倡导精神，无论通过音乐还是行动主义，都体现了确保所有人都被听见和重视的坚定承诺。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: BoM issues a fresh 'super' El Niño reality check for Australia
title.zh: 气象局就澳大利亚的“超级”厄尔尼诺现象发出新的现实检验

summary.en: Australia's current El Niño event is projected to be one of the strongest on record, with record-breaking sea surface temperatures in the Pacific Ocean. However, the Bureau of Meteorology (BoM) has advised that the strength of an El Niño does not directly correlate with the severity of its impacts in Australia, as...
summary.zh: 澳大利亚目前发生的厄尔尼诺现象预计将是有记录以来最强之一，太平洋海表温度将创下新高。然而，澳大利亚气象局（BoM）警告说，厄尔尼诺现象的强度并不直接决定其在澳大利亚影响的严重程度，因为还有其他气候驱动因素会影响天气模式。

body.en:
Australia's current El Niño could become the strongest on record, but the Bureau of Meteorology (BoM) has cautioned that doesn't necessarily mean the country is headed for an exceptionally hot and dry summer.

The BoM says models indicate the El Niño underway in the Pacific Ocean could produce the highest central tropical Pacific sea surface temperature anomaly since reliable records began in 1950.

But it has stressed the strength of an El Niño does not directly determine how severe its impacts will be in Australia, with several other climate drivers influencing rainfall and temperatures.

An El Niño occurs when sea surface temperatures in parts of the central and eastern tropical Pacific Ocean become unusually warm, triggering changes in atmospheric circulation and weather patterns.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The BoM says the current event is likely to become the strongest recorded based on forecast sea surface temperatures in the central tropical Pacific.

During the 1982-83 El Niño, which currently holds the record, sea surface temperature anomalies peaked at around 2.6C above average in January 1983.

However, the BoM has warned against assuming a stronger El Niño automatically means more extreme conditions for Australia.

"Every El Niño is different," it said in an advisory it released on Tuesday.

"A strong event can produce only modest effects in some regions, while a weaker event can have significant impacts."

Australia's weather is influenced by a combination of climate drivers, including El Niño, the Indian Ocean Dipole (IOD), surrounding sea surface temperatures and seasonal changes, as well as the longer-term effects of climate change.

The previous El Niño, which developed in spring 2023 and continued into early 2024, was considered a moderate-to-strong event.

The current El Niño is likely to continue through spring and summer, although its influence on Australian rainfall typically diminishes around early summer.

The BoM's latest long-range forecast, issued on 10 September, shows most of Australia is likely to experience above-average temperatures over the coming months.

Between October and December, below-average rainfall is likely across parts of south-eastern Australia, including southern NSW, Victoria and Tasmania.

Most of Western Australia, as well as some central and northern parts of the country, are instead forecast to receive above-average rainfall.

The IOD is currently neutral, but all climate models suggest a positive IOD could develop later in spring. A positive IOD can increase the likelihood of drier spring conditions, particularly across southern and...
body.zh: 澳大利亚目前的厄尔尼诺现象可能会成为有记录以来最强的厄尔尼诺现象，但气象局（BoM）警告说，这并不一定意味着该国将迎来异常炎热干燥的夏季。 BoM 表示，模型显示，太平洋中正在发生的厄尔尼诺现象可能会产生自 1950 年有可靠记录以来最高的中部热带太平洋海面温度异常。 但它强调，厄尔尼诺现象的强度并不直接决定其对澳大利亚的影响有多严重，其他几个气候驱动因素也会影响降雨量和气温。 当热带太平洋中部和东部部分地区的海面温度变得异常温暖，引发大气环流和天气模式的变化时，就会发生厄尔尼诺现象。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 气象局表示，根据热带太平洋中部海面温度的预测，当前的事件可能会成为有记录以来最强烈的事件。 1982-83 年厄尔尼诺现象（目前这一记录保持者）期间，海面温度异常在 1983 年 1 月达到峰值，比平均水平高出约 2.6 摄氏度。 然而，央行警告不要假设更强的厄尔尼诺现象自动意味着澳大利亚将面临更极端的情况。 “每次厄尔尼诺现象都是不同的，”它在周二发布的一份报告中表示。 “强烈的事件只能在某些地区产生适度的影响，而较弱的事件可能会产生重大影响。” 澳大利亚的天气受到多种气候驱动因素的影响，包括厄尔尼诺现象、印度洋偶极子 (IOD)、周围海面温度和季节变化，以及气候变化的长期影响。 上一次厄尔尼诺现象发生于 2023 年春季，一直持续到 2024 年初，被认为是中度至强度事件。 当前的厄尔尼诺现象可能会持续整个春季和夏季，尽管其对澳大利亚降雨量的影响通常会在初夏左右减弱。 BoM 9 月 10 日发布的最新长期预测显示，未来几个月澳大利亚大部分地区的气温可能会高于平均水平。 十月至十二月期间，澳大利亚东南部部分地区的降雨量可能低于平均水平，包括新南威尔士州南部、维多利亚州和塔斯马尼亚州。 西澳大利亚州的大部分地区以及该国中部和北部的一些地区预计降雨量将高于平均水平。 IOD 目前为中性，但所有气候模型都表明 IOD 可能会在春季晚些时候出现正值。正 IOD 会增加春季干燥的可能性，特别是在南部和......

reflection.en: The Bureau of Meteorology's careful assessment reminds us that even strong phenomena require nuanced understanding. While the El Niño is exceptionally potent, its precise effects are complex and influenced by many factors. This calls for discernment, looking beyond the obvious to understand the full picture, rather than making assumptions based on a single...
reflection.zh: 澳大利亚气象局的审慎评估提醒我们，即使是强大的现象也需要细致的理解。尽管厄尔尼诺现象异常强烈，但其具体影响是复杂的，并受到多种因素的影响。这要求我们具备辨别力，超越表面现象去理解全貌，而不是基于单一的强大指标就做出假设。

title.en: 'Really problematic': Australians are rejecting the very homes the country needs
title.zh: “非常成问题”：澳大利亚人正在拒绝国家急需的住房

summary.en: Concerns are mounting that Australia's housing crisis may be exacerbated if the current trend of buyers rejecting newly-built homes persists, as sales have fallen for four consecutive months to their lowest level in over a year.
summary.zh: 人们越来越担心，如果买家拒绝新房的趋势持续下去，澳大利亚的住房危机可能会加剧，新房销售已连续四个月下降，达到一年多来的最低水平。

body.en:
Buyers appear to be rejecting newly-built homes, sparking concerns Australia's property market slowdown could worsen a chronic housing shortage.

Sales of new homes fell 10 per cent nationally in August and were 19.3 per cent lower in the three months to August compared with the previous quarter, according to new data from the Housing Industry Association (HIA).

Sales have now fallen for four consecutive months to their lowest level in more than a year.

The slowdown was recorded across all five mainland states included in the HIA survey, which tracks sales by large-volume home builders and is considered a leading indicator of future detached home construction.

Victoria recorded the sharpest quarterly decline, with sales down 27 per cent, followed by Queensland at 20.2 per cent, NSW at 17.5 per cent, South Australia at 10.8 per cent and Western Australia at 8.2 per cent.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

HIA chief economist Tim Reardon said the deterioration meant the recovery in new home building seen earlier this year had been interrupted.

"Today's new home sales are tomorrow's housing commencements," he said in a statement.

"The decline in sales through the middle of 2026 will mean fewer homes commencing construction in 2027."

Independent property economist Cameron Kusher told SBS News that a combination of higher borrowing costs and low confidence was making it increasingly difficult to buy a new home. But he warned that if sales continued to decline leading to fewer builds, it could lead to even higher prices in the future.

"We're seeing really weak confidence around the housing market generally at the moment," he told SBS News.

Tim Lawless, the research director at property data firm Cotality, said the slowdown was also evident across the broader property market, although new homes appeared to have been hit harder.

Cotality estimates home sales across the broader market were about 15 per cent lower over winter than a year earlier and 11 per cent below the five-year average.

"It does look like new home sales have been hit a little bit harder," Lawless said, pointing to higher interest rates, weaker confidence, reduced investment and affordability and serviceability constraints.

The slowdown has been particularly pronounced in Sydney, Brisbane and Perth, where Cotality estimates home sales fell by more than 20 per cent over winter compared with the same period last year.

Lawless said Brisbane and Perth were coming off relatively strong levels of activity, while Sydney's decline was more reflective of severe affordability constraints.

Proverbs 11:14 reminds us that 'where there is no guidance, a people falls, but in an abundance of counselors there is safety.' This suggests that a lack of wise counsel or a failure to heed market signals...

title.en: Nyadol Nyuon responds to criticism over 'no white culture' remarks
title.zh: 尼亚多尔·尼翁回应关于‘没有白人文化’言论的批评

summary.en: Lawyer and human rights advocate Nyadol Nyuon has defended her remarks on culture and assimilation, stating that her love for Australia is deep, and that the term 'Anglo-Celtic culture' can imply a single 'white culture' that migrants are expected to adopt.
summary.zh: 律师兼人权倡导者尼亚多尔·尼翁为她关于文化和同化的言论进行了辩护，表示她对澳大利亚的爱是深厚的，并认为“盎格鲁-凯尔特文化”一词可能暗示着一种移民被期望采纳的单一“白人文化”。

body.en:
Lawyer and human rights advocate Nyadol Nyuon has defended her claim that there is "no white culture" after remarks she made turning a televised debate drew criticism.

Nyuon appeared on the ABC's National Forum on migration on Monday, where she rejected the idea Australia was historically monocultural and said she had "no intention of assimilating".

But she stressed that did not mean rejecting Australia, its laws or the country she says she "deeply" loves.

She argued that describing Australia as an "Anglo-Celtic culture" risked creating the impression there was a single "white culture" migrants were expected to adopt.

"There is Italian culture, there is French culture, there is Argentinian culture, but there is not this notion of sort of a white culture that is being threatened," Nyuon told the forum.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The discussion came amid a broader national debate about migration, multiculturalism and what it means to be Australian.

Following criticism of her remarks, Nyuon expanded on the argument in a social media post on her LinkedIn account.

"Apparently, saying there is no white culture has offended some people," she wrote on Tuesday.

Nyuon argued that race and culture should not be treated as interchangeable, pointing to the cultural differences that exist between people who may otherwise be grouped together according to skin colour.

"Black is a colour, not a culture. There are Black people. There is Ethiopian culture," she wrote.

Nyuon also defended her argument that Australia had never been monocultural, pointing to the hundreds of First Nations that existed before colonisation as well as the long histories of Chinese migrants and Afghan cameleers in Australia.

During the forum, former deputy prime minister John Anderson argued there were legitimate concerns among Australians about social cohesion and whether some groups respected Australian culture and values.

Anderson described those values as including individual dignity, equality before the law and the separation of the secular and sacred.

Nyuon acknowledged Australians had a right to be concerned about threats to social cohesion but challenged the way the issue was being framed.

She argued the migration debate could become a proxy for conversations about race and questioned why a person's appearance should influence perceptions of their belonging.

"Whenever we attempt to speak about how our belonging can look like, you meet such resistance, and the majority of the time that resistance comes from how you look," she said on Monday.

Nyuon also spoke about her complicated relationship with Australia and her previously announced intention to begin the...
body.zh: 律师兼人权倡导者尼亚多尔·纽翁 (Nyadol Nyuon) 在一场电视辩论中发表的言论招致批评后，为她“不存在白人文化”的说法进行了辩护。 周一，纽恩出现在美国广播公司关于移民的全国论坛上，她在论坛上否认了澳大利亚历来是单一文化的观点，并表示她“无意同化”。 但她强调，这并不意味着拒绝澳大利亚、其法律或她所说的她“深深”热爱的国家。 她认为，将澳大利亚描述为“盎格鲁-凯尔特文化”可能会造成移民应该接受单一“白人文化”的印象。 “有意大利文化，有法国文化，有阿根廷文化，但没有这种受到威胁的白人文化的概念，”纽翁在论坛上说。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 这次讨论是在一场关于移民、多元文化主义以及作为澳大利亚人意味着什么的更广泛的全国性辩论中进行的。 在她的言论受到批评后，Nyuon 在她的 LinkedIn 帐户上的社交媒体帖子中进一步阐述了这一论点。 “显然，说没有白人文化冒犯了一些人，”她周二写道。 纽翁认为，种族和文化不应被视为可以互换，并指出人们之间存在文化差异，否则这些人可能会根据肤色进行分组。 “黑色是一种颜色，而不是一种文化。有黑人。有埃塞俄比亚文化，”她写道。 纽翁还为自己的论点进行了辩护，即澳大利亚从来都不是单一文化，她指出在殖民化之前就存在着数百个原住民，以及澳大利亚的中国移民和阿富汗驼夫的悠久历史。 在论坛上，前副总理约翰·安德森表示，澳大利亚人对社会凝聚力以及某些群体是否尊重澳大利亚文化和价值观存在合理的担忧。 安德森将这些价值观描述为包括个人尊严、法律面前人人平等以及世俗与神圣的分离。 纽翁承认澳大利亚人有权担心社会凝聚力受到的威胁，但对问题的表述方式提出了质疑。 她认为，移民辩论可能成为种族对话的代表，并质疑为什么一个人的外表会影响对其归属感的看法。 “每当我们试图谈论我们的归属感是什么样子时，你都会遇到这样的阻力，而大多数时候这种阻力来自于你的外表，”她周一说道。 Nyuon 还谈到了她与澳大利亚的复杂关系以及她之前宣布的开始......

reflection.en: Words carry immense power, shaping how we understand ourselves and others. Nyadol Nyuon's defense of her comments highlights how language can either build bridges or erect barriers. The challenge is to speak in ways that foster understanding and respect, even when discussing complex issues of identity and belonging.
reflection.zh: 言语拥有巨大的力量，塑造着我们对自身和他人的理解。尼亚多尔·尼翁为她的言论辩护，凸显了语言可以搭建桥梁，也可以竖起障碍。挑战在于以促进理解和尊重的方式说话，即使在讨论身份和归属感的复杂问题时也是如此。

verse.textEn: The tongue has the power of life and death, and those who love it will eat its fruit.
verse.textZh: 生死在舌头的权下；喜爱它的，必吃它所结的果子。

Chief Executive John Lee Ka-chiu dedicated a portion of the city's inaugural five-year...

Chief Executive John Lee Ka-chiu on Wednesday devoted part of the city’s first five-year plan and his annual policy address to developing a gold trading ecosystem and creating a regional intellectual property trading centre in the city. “We will consolidate and enhance Hong Kong’s status as an...

reflection.en: Hong Kong's ambitious plan to boost the yuan's global role through strategic financial initiatives reflects a significant human endeavor. As leaders and policymakers commit to such large-scale projects, the ancient wisdom of Proverbs 16:3 reminds us to entrust our efforts to Yahweh, seeking His guidance and blessing for success and integrity in all our...
reflection.zh: 香港通过战略性金融举措来提升人民币全球角色的宏伟计划，体现了人类的重大努力。当领导者和政策制定者致力于如此大规模的项目时，《箴言》16:3 的古老智慧提醒我们，要将我们的努力交托给雅伟，在所有事业中寻求祂的指引和祝福，以获得成功和正直。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.

This ambitious goal, revealed by Chief Executive John Lee Ka-chiu, includes measures to foster frontier technologies like aerospace...

body.en: Hong Kong will strive to raise its expenditure on innovation activities to a level equivalent to 3 per cent of gross domestic product (GDP) by around 2030, nearly double the current rate, according to the city’s first five-year plan. Chief Executive John Lee Ka-chiu unveiled the ambitious goal, together with measures to boost frontier technologies, including aerospace research, on Wednesday. Among the 22 indicators laid out in the plan, the government aims to raise the ratio of total domestic...
body.zh: 根据香港第一个五年计划，香港将力争到2030年左右将创新活动支出提高到相当于国内生产总值(GDP)3%的水平，几乎是目前水平的两倍。周三，行政长官李家超公布了这一雄心勃勃的目标，以及促进包括航空航天研究在内的前沿技术的措施。在该计划提出的22项指标中，政府的目标是提高国内生产总值的比例...

reflection.en: The government of Hong Kong has set a clear goal to significantly increase investment in innovation and technology over the next decade. This strategic commitment reflects a desire for progress and development. As they embark on this ambitious plan, may they commit their endeavors to Yahweh, seeking His wisdom and guidance for fruitful outcomes.

summary.en: Hong Kong police have arrested a man in connection with the death of his wife, whose body was discovered with knife wounds in their flat at the Heng Fa Chuen residential estate. The 53-year-old woman was pronounced dead at the scene, and a 52-year-old man was arrested as an investigation begins.
summary.zh: 香港警方逮捕了一名男子，此前他在恒发邨的公寓内发现妻子死亡，身上有刀伤。这名53岁的女子当场被宣布死亡，一名52岁的男子随后被捕，警方已展开调查。

body.en: Hong Kong police have arrested a man on suspicion of murder after his wife was found dead in a flat at a private residential estate. The force said the woman, 53, was discovered with knife wounds to her neck in a flat in block 2 of Heng Fa Chuen in Chai Wan at about 7.50pm on Wednesday, a police spokesman said. She was confirmed dead at the scene. Officers arrested the man, 52, and announced that an investigation was under way. Heng Fa Chuen is a major private waterfront residential estate...

reflection.en: The discovery of a woman dead in her home, bearing knife wounds, is a stark reminder of the hidden violence that can occur behind closed doors. This tragedy speaks to the profound need to protect the vulnerable within our communities, especially those in domestic situations where trust has been broken and safety compromised. May we pray for justice and...
reflection.zh: 一名女子在家中被发现死亡，身上带有刀伤，这一发现令人痛心，也警示了隐藏在门后的暴力。这一悲剧凸显了保护社区中弱势群体的迫切需要，尤其是在信任破裂、安全受到威胁的家庭环境中。愿我们为受此类暴力影响的人们祈求公义与医治。

title.en: Condolence points to be set up for Tung Chee-hwa
title.zh: 设吊唁点供公众悼念董建华

summary.en: Hong Kong's first chief executive, Tung Chee-hwa, passed away on September 8 at the age of 89. Condolence books will be available across the city from Friday for the public to pay their respects. A private vigil is scheduled for Saturday, followed by a public memorial service on Sunday.
summary.zh: 香港首任行政长官董建华于9月8日逝世，享年89岁。从周五开始，全港将设立吊唁点供公众签署吊唁簿致意。周六将举行私人守灵仪式，周日则有公众追思会。

body.en: Members of the public can pay their respects to Hong Kong's first chief executive Tung Chee-hwa by signing condolence books across the city starting on Friday. The condolence points -- Moreton Terrace Activities Centre in Causeway Bay, Kai Tak Community Hall and Sai Lau Kok Garden in Tsuen Wan --will open between 9am and 9pm on Friday and Saturday, and from 9am to noon on Sunday. Tung passed away on September 8 at the age of 89. A private vigil will take place on Saturday at the Hong Kong Funeral Home in North Point, followed by a public memorial service on Sunday. Edited by Raymond Yeung
body.zh: 从周五开始，公众可以在全市范围内签名吊唁簿，表达对香港首任特首董建华的敬意。铜锣湾摩顿台活动中心、荃湾启德社区会堂和西楼角花园等慰问点将于周五和周六上午 9 点至晚上 9 点开放，周日上午 9 点至中午 12 点开放。董先生于 9 月 8 日去世，享年 89 岁。周六将在北角香港殡仪馆举行私人守夜活动，周日将举行公众追悼会。杨雷蒙编辑

reflection.en: The passing of Tung Chee-hwa, Hong Kong's first chief executive, at age 89 marks the end of a life and invites reflection on mortality. Hebrews 9:27 reminds us that death is a universal appointment, a shared human experience that calls us to consider our own lives and legacies.
reflection.zh: 香港首任行政长官董建华先生以89岁高龄辞世，标志着一个生命的终结，并引人深思生命的无常。希伯来书9章27节提醒我们，死亡是人人必经的定数，是人类共同的经历，促使我们反思自己的生命和所留下的印记。

verse.textEn: Just as people are destined to die once, and after that to face judgment.
verse.textZh: 按着定命，人人都有一死，死后且有审判。

title.en: Universities 'compelled' to seek funding for new towns
title.zh: 大学被“迫”为新城寻求资金

summary.en: A lawmaker welcomed the government's financial backing for universities to establish satellite campuses in the Northern Metropolis, but stressed the importance of institutions developing sustainable long-term funding strategies beyond the initial setup phase. The plan involves developing three university towns...
summary.zh: 一位立法会议员对政府为大学在北部都会区设立附属校园提供财政支持表示欢迎，但强调了机构在初期建设之后制定可持续长期资金策略的重要性。该计划涉及开发三个大学城，总面积超过1000公顷，政府将提供土地溢价减免和贷款，而大学则需要动用其储备金或探索发行债券等灵活的融资模式。

body.en: A lawmaker on Wednesday welcomed the government's financial backing for universities to set up satellite campuses in the Northern Metropolis, but said institutions still need to have long-term funding plans once they get off the ground. Under the city's Five-Year Plan, three university towns totalling more than 1,000 hectares are to be developed in the Northern Metropolis. Chief Executive John Lee has pledged land premium concessions and loans, while the institutions involved will "mobilise their reserves and/or employ flexible funding modes" such as issuing bonds to bring in market and social capital. Legislator Lau Chi-pang, also a university professor, said the move will compel institutions to find ways to finance the university towns. "The financial support will basically be sort of seed money for universities to give a start to the project. I guess universities and the government will have to put their hands together to look for money because we are talking about huge space in the Northern Metropolis," he said. "It will be a very extended period of development, so it costs quite a lot of money." The Hung Shui Kiu university town will be the pioneer among the three, with institutions scheduled to move as soon as next year. Lau said the estimate is pragmatic. "Because the Hung Shui Kiu area is good enough to provide a space for a few universities to start their business here," he said. "I guess this is a stage that wouldn't have any problem with budgeting or development." Edited by Raymond Yeung
body.zh: 周三，一名立法者对政府为大学在北部大都市建立卫星校园提供的财政支持表示欢迎，但表示，一旦启动，机构仍需要制定长期资助计划。根据该市的五年规划，北部大都市将开发三个总面积超过1000公顷的大学城。行政长官李家超已承诺提供土地溢价优惠和贷款，而相关机构将“动用储备金和/或采用灵活的融资方式”，例如发行债券以引入市场和社会资本。立法会议员、大学教授刘志鹏表示，此举将迫使各机构想方设法为大学城提供资金。 “财政支持基本上是大学启动该项目的种子资金。我想大学和政府将不得不齐心协力寻找资金，因为我们正在谈论北方大都市的巨大空间，”他说。 “这将是一个非常长的开发周期，因此需要花费相当多的资金。”洪水桥大学城将是这三个大学城中的先驱，学校计划最快明年搬迁。刘说这个估计是务实的。 “因为洪水桥地区足够好，可以为一些大学在这里开展业务提供空间，”他说。 “我想这个阶段不会有任何预算或开发问题。”杨雷蒙编辑

reflection.en: The development of new university towns in Hong Kong's Northern Metropolis is a significant undertaking, requiring careful planning and financial foresight. As these institutions are compelled to seek funding, the principle of committing one's endeavors to divine guidance offers a framework for responsible stewardship and sustainable growth. May wisdom...
reflection.zh: 香港北部都会区新建大学城的开发是一项重大工程，需要周密的规划和长远的财务眼光。当这些机构被要求寻求资金时，将自己的事业托付于神的原则，为负责任的管理和可持续发展提供了框架。愿智慧引导其领导者，确保资源的获取，并建立服务于子孙后代的机构。
