body.zh: 多年来，科学家们一直困惑为什么金星尽管在大小、质量和整体结构上与地球相似，但却没有卫星。加州大学河滨分校的新研究提出了一个惊人的可能性：金星可能曾经有过卫星，但最终将其拉回了地球。 之前的解释通常集中在两种可能性。有人认为金星曾经有一颗卫星，后来因一次巨大的撞击而被摧毁。另一位提出，金星根本就没有经历过最初可能形成月球的那种碰撞。 《天体物理学杂志》上发表的一项新研究提供了不同的解释。根据这项研究，金星可能不需要发生剧烈的外部事件就能失去卫星。 “我的研究表明，金星不需要一场灾难就能达到我们今天所看到的样子，”加州大学河滨分校的天体物理学家兼主要作者斯蒂芬·凯恩说。 “事实证明，行星本身的引力加上它自然旋转的速度导致月球在它上面塌陷。” 科学家们知道，月球正在逐渐远离我们，因为阿波罗11号任务在月球表面留下了镜子，使研究人员能够极其精确地测量地月距离。 凯恩说：“我们知道月球正在以每年约四厘米的速度慢慢远离地球。” 这种运动与地球相对较快的自转密切相关。我们的星球大约在 24 小时内完成自转一圈。与旋转相关的一些能量被转移到月球上，随着时间的推移，有助于将其缓慢向外推。 金星自转一周大约需要 243 个地球日。由于金星自转速度如此缓慢，金星周围的卫星不一定会像地球的月球那样向外迁移。相反，金星的引力及其缓慢的自转可能会导致月球逐渐向内螺旋，直到与行星相撞。 为了研究这种可能性，凯恩开发了计算机模型来模拟行星和卫星如何通过重力相互作用。 他首先使用地球和月球测试了该模型，重现了系统的已知演化，以确认模拟的行为真实。 凯恩随后将该模型应用于金星。他改变了行星的自转速度，并测试了假想的卫星，其质量范围从月球质量的一半到其质量的十倍。 在大多数模拟中，结果非常一致。月球最终撞上了金星。 “当我做出这个发现时，我感到震惊，”凯恩说。 “我认为我正在探索的广泛场景肯定会导致不同的结果。但一切都几乎朝着同一个方向发展。” 模拟并不能证明金星实际上曾经有过卫星。凯恩认为这是...

reflection.en: The vastness of the cosmos and the intricate dance of celestial bodies continue to reveal profound truths about the universe. As scientists uncover new possibilities, like Venus potentially reclaiming its moon, we are reminded of the intricate wisdom embedded in creation itself. 'Ask the animals,' the ancient text advises, 'and they will teach you; the...
reflection.zh: 宇宙的浩瀚和天体的复杂运行继续揭示着关于宇宙的深刻真理。当科学家们发现新的可能性，比如金星可能吞噬了自己的月球时，我们被提醒，创造本身就蕴含着精妙的智慧。“问问走兽，它们会教导你；天空的飞鸟，它们会告诉你。” 诸天都在述说雅伟的荣耀，对它们的探究可以引导我们获得更深的理解。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Colombia and Brazil deadliest countries for environmental activists, report says
title.zh: 报告称哥伦比亚和巴西是环境活动家最致命的国家

summary.en: A Global Witness report states that Colombia and Brazil accounted for 52% of the killings of environmental activists globally in 2025. Latin America remains the deadliest region for these activists, with land disputes often being the motive behind the violence.
summary.zh: 根据全球见证组织（Global Witness）的一份报告，哥伦比亚和巴西占2025年全球环境活动家被杀人数的52%。拉丁美洲仍然是这些活动家最危险的地区，土地纠纷常常是暴力事件的动机。

body.en:
Colombia has again topped the list of countries with the highest number of killings of land and environmental activists, according to an annual report by campaign group Global Witness , external .

Out of at least 124 activists killed globally in 2025, 39 were murdered in Colombia, followed by Brazil with 26.

Global Witness says that 85% of the documented killings took place in Latin America, making it the deadliest region for every year since the group started publishing its reports in 2012.

Most of the killings were part of land disputes and in many cases they were carried out by hitmen or members of organised crime gangs, the report states.

Colombia has accounted for the highest number of murders of environmental activists for the past four years.

Almost half of those killed in the country were members of indigenous groups, while many of the remaining ones were small-scale farmers, Global Witness's report says.

Many indigenous groups in Colombia have created their own protection networks in the form of indigenous guards, which patrol their territory but are unarmed.

Members of indigenous guards are often targeted by illegal armed groups looking to expand their territory to plant coca - the raw material used to make cocaine - or to engage in illegal mining.

Last week, Jacob Guachetá Zambrano, who was part of the indigenous guard in Colombia's Cauca region, was found tortured and killed.

While the possible motive behind his murder is still under investigation and the search for the perpetrator is ongoing, indigenous leaders said that murders, threats and forced disappearances in the area were common as illegal armed groups battled for territory.

Global Witness warned that Brazil had seen a doubling of killings of environmental defenders in 2025 compared to 2024.

As in Colombia, in Brazil most of the cases the group documented were primarily driven by conflict over land, Global Witness's researchers found.

Outside of Latin America, 12% of the murders occurred in Asia, with Philippines top of the list with 12 documented murders.

The group warned that while globally the number of documented killings had gone down from 146 in 2024 to 128 in 2025, its numbers were probably an underestimate as many cases went unreported.
body.zh: 根据活动组织全球见证的年度报告，哥伦比亚再次位列杀害土地和环保活动人士最多的国家名单中。 2025 年，全球至少有 124 名活动人士被杀，其中哥伦比亚有 39 人被杀，巴西紧随其后，有 26 人被杀。 Global Witness 表示，有记录的杀戮事件中有 85% 发生在拉丁美洲，自该组织 2012 年开始发布报告以来，拉丁美洲每年都是死亡人数最严重的地区。 报告指出，大多数杀戮都是土地纠纷的一部分，许多情况下是由杀手或有组织犯罪团伙成员实施的。 过去四年来，哥伦比亚是环境活动人士被谋杀人数最多的国家。 全球见证的报告称，该国遇害者中近一半是土著群体成员，其余许多人是小农。 哥伦比亚的许多土著群体以土著警卫的形式建立了自己的保护网络，他们在其领土上巡逻，但不携带武器。 土著警卫成员经常成为非法武装团体的目标，这些团体寻求扩大领土种植古柯（用于制造可卡因的原材料）或从事非法采矿。 上周，哥伦比亚考卡地区土著警卫成员雅各布·瓜切塔·赞布拉诺 (Jacob Guachetá Zambrano) 被发现遭受酷刑并被杀害。 虽然谋杀背后的可能动机仍在调查中，对凶手的搜寻也在进行中，但土著领导人表示，由于非法武装团体争夺领土，该地区的谋杀、威胁和强迫失踪很常见。 全球见证警告称，与 2024 年相比，2025 年巴西环境捍卫者遇害人数增加了一倍。 全球见证的研究人员发现，与哥伦比亚一样，在巴西，该组织记录的大多数案件主要是由土地冲突引起的。 在拉丁美洲以外，12% 的谋杀案发生在亚洲，其中菲律宾以 12 起记录在案的谋杀案位居榜首。 该组织警告说，虽然全球记录在案的杀戮数量已从 2024 年的 146 起减少到 2025 年的 128 起，但这一数字可能被低估，因为许多案件没有报告。

reflection.en: This report paints a grim picture of the dangers faced by those who defend our planet. The 124 activists killed in 2025, many in land disputes, remind us of the courage required to stand for creation and for the rights of marginalized communities. We are called to lend our voices to those whose lives are threatened for protecting the earth.
reflection.zh: 这份报告描绘了一幅严峻的画面，揭示了那些捍卫我们星球的人所面临的危险。2025年有124名活动家被杀，其中许多人卷入了土地纠纷，这提醒我们，为保护造物和边缘化社区的权利而奋斗需要何等的勇气。我们被呼召为那些因保护地球而生命受到威胁的人发出声音。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: White-tailed eagle chicks fledge for fourth year
title.zh: 白尾海雕幼鸟连续第四年成功离巢

summary.en: A reintroduction project, initiated in 2019 by Forestry England and the Roy Dennis Wildlife Foundation, has achieved a significant milestone with white-tailed eagle chicks successfully fledging from wild nests in England for the fourth consecutive year. This year, two pairs successfully bred, resulting in one chick...
summary.zh: 由英格兰林业局和罗伊·丹尼斯野生动物基金会于2019年发起的重新引入项目取得了重要里程碑，白尾海雕幼鸟连续第四年在英格兰的野外巢穴中成功离巢。今年，有两对成功繁殖，一只幼鸟在多塞特郡离巢，另有两只在苏塞克斯郡，使自2019年以来野外出生的鸟类总数达到九只。

body.en:
White-tailed eagle chicks have successfully fledged from wild nests in England for the fourth consecutive year.

Two out of five pairs of eagles released by a reintroduction project successfully bred and raised young with one chick fledging from a nest in Dorset and two more in Sussex.

The project, run by Forestry England and the Roy Dennis Wildlife Foundation, aims to return the species to England . Nine birds have been born in the wild since it began in 2019.

"This year's breeding success is another important milestone in the return of this lost species to England; it shows what can be achieved by very skilled wildlife managers," Roy Dennis OBE from the foundation said.

The foundation has called the breeding attempts "remarkable", adding that one of the male adult birds has only one leg after losing it five years ago.

Human persecution had caused the bird's extinction, with the last pair breeding in southern England in 1780.

"Restoring a species takes many years and requires the support of a wide range of communities and organisations, in particular landowners and farmers," Dennis added.

Steve Egerton-Read, white-tailed eagle project officer for Forestry England, said: "We are delighted that these three chicks made it through and will be closely watching their progress as they begin to explore the landscape."

To date, 56 young white-tailed eagles have been released including, for the first time this year, additional releases of six birds at Exmoor National Park, in partnership with Exmoor National Park Authority.

body.zh: 白尾鹰雏鸟连续第四年成功从英格兰的野生巢穴中羽翼丰满。 放归项目放归的五对鹰中，有两对成功繁殖并抚养幼鹰，其中一只雏鹰从多塞特郡的巢穴中孵出雏鸟，另外两只则在苏塞克斯郡的巢中。 该项目由英格兰林业局和罗伊丹尼斯野生动物基金会运营，旨在将该物种带回英格兰。自 2019 年开始以来，已有 9 只鸟在野外出生。 该基金会的罗伊·丹尼斯 OBE 表示：“今年的繁殖成功是这一消失物种回归英格兰的又一个重要里程碑；它展示了非常熟练的野生动物管理者可以取得的成就。” 该基金会称这些繁殖尝试“非常了不起”，并补充说，其中一只雄性成年鸟五年前失去了一条腿，现在只剩下一条腿。 人类的迫害导致了这种鸟的灭绝，最后一对鸟于 1780 年在英格兰南部繁殖。 “恢复一个物种需要很多年的时间，需要广泛的社区和组织的支持，特别是土地所有者和农民，”丹尼斯补充道。 英格兰林业局白尾鹰项目官员史蒂夫·埃格顿-里德（Steve Egerton-Read）表示：“我们很高兴这三只小鹰能够顺利通过，并将在它们开始探索这片土地时密切关注它们的进展。” 迄今为止，已释放了 56 只幼年白尾海雕，其中今年首次与埃克斯穆尔国家公园管理局合作在埃克斯穆尔国家公园额外释放了 6 只幼鸟。 在 Facebook、external、X、external 和 Instagram、external 上关注 BBC Sussex，并在 Sounds 上收听 BBC Radio Sussex。将您的故事想法发送至Southeasttoday@bbc.co.uk、外部或WhatsApp我们08081 002250。

reflection.en: The successful return of the white-tailed eagle to England, marked by these fledging chicks, is a profound reminder of the intricate beauty and resilience of creation. It speaks to the wisdom inherent in the natural world, a testament to the Creator's design that continues to unfold before us. May we, like these dedicated wildlife managers, approach the...
reflection.zh: 白尾海雕成功重返英格兰，以这些离巢的幼鸟为标志，深刻地提醒我们造物的精妙之美和韧性。它彰显了自然界固有的智慧，是创造者设计不断在我们面前展开的见证。 愿我们像这些敬业的野生动物管理者一样，以技巧和敬畏之心来管理造物，认识到生命在获得机会时所绽放的奇妙。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: Plantwatch: The insect-eating alpine plant that proves Darwin was right
title.zh: 植物观察：证明达尔文是正确的食虫高山植物

summary.en: A study has shown that Saxifraga candelabrum, a small alpine plant, traps and digests midges, confirming a prediction made by Charles Darwin in 1875. The plant's leaves, petals, and stems are covered in tiny, sticky hairs that lure and trap insects, which are then digested by an enzyme.
summary.zh: 一项研究表明，一种名为虎耳草（Saxifraga candelabrum）的小型高山植物能够捕捉并消化蠓虫，证实了查尔斯·达尔文在1875年提出的预测。该植物的叶子、花瓣和茎上覆盖着微小的粘性毛发，可以引诱并捕捉昆虫，然后通过酶进行消化。

body.en: Study shows Saxifraga candelabrum traps and digests midges – just as the evolutionary biologist predicted back in 1875 In 1875, Charles Darwin predicted that Saxifraga candelabrum , a small alpine plant, could eat insects. Its leaves, petals and stems are smothered in tiny, sticky hairs and – just as the evolutionary biologist suspected – the sweet glue on the hairs can lure and trap midges before digesting them with an enzyme. Continue reading...
body.zh: 研究表明虎耳草能捕获并消化蚊子——正如进化生物学家在 1875 年预测的那样。1875 年，查尔斯·达尔文预测虎耳草（一种小型高山植物）可以吃昆虫。它的叶子、花瓣和茎上都覆盖着细小的粘性毛发，正如进化生物学家所怀疑的那样，毛发上的甜味胶可以引诱并捕获蚊子，然后用酶消化它们。继续阅读...

reflection.en: It is remarkable how the intricate details of creation reveal profound truths. This small alpine plant, Saxifraga candelabrum, demonstrates a complex survival strategy that even Charles Darwin recognized as evidence of nature's ingenuity. Observing such phenomena reminds us of the wisdom inherent in the natural world, a wisdom that points beyond itself.
reflection.zh: 造物的精妙细节揭示深刻真理，这令人惊叹。这种名为虎耳草的小型高山植物展示了一种复杂的生存策略，连查尔斯·达尔文都认为这是自然界智慧的证据。观察这样的现象，提醒我们自然界本身蕴含着智慧，而这智慧指向超越自身的存在。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: UK mathematician debunks myth around Parthenon’s optical illusions
title.zh: 英国数学家揭开帕特农神庙光学错觉神话

summary.en: A recent study by a mathematician challenges the long-held belief that the Parthenon's subtle curves were intentionally designed to counteract optical illusions, suggesting this was a myth rather than a deliberate architectural choice for aesthetic correction.
summary.zh: 一项由数学家进行的新研究挑战了长期以来认为帕特农神庙的精妙曲线是为了抵消光学错觉而设计的观点，表明这可能是一个神话，而非出于美学修正的刻意建筑选择。

body.en: Study challenges belief that temple’s curves were designed to correct optical illusions that would have ruined its clean lines A mathematician has uncovered what may be one of the longest-running myths in history after studying optical illusions and the Parthenon, the famed Greek temple that overlooks Athens. Scholars have marvelled at the building on the Acropolis hill for more than 2,000 years and heaped praise on its architects for their clever use of geometry. Its subtle curves are said to correct optical illusions that would have otherwise ruined the Parthenon’s clean lines. Continue reading...
body.zh: 研究挑战了一种观点，即神庙的曲线是为了纠正视错觉而设计的，这种错觉会破坏其干净的线条。一位数学家在研究了视错觉和俯瞰雅典的著名希腊神庙帕台农神庙后，发现了可能是历史上最长的神话之一。两千多年来，学者们一直对卫城山上的这座建筑惊叹不已，并对其建筑师对几何学的巧妙运用赞不绝口。据说，其微妙的曲线可以纠正视错觉，否则会破坏帕台农神庙简洁的线条。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The pursuit of knowledge, whether through ancient architecture or the natural world, reflects a deep human impulse to understand the order and beauty around us. As Job 12:7 reminds us, 'Ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds of the air, and they will tell you,' suggesting that wisdom is often found in careful observation of creation's...
reflection.zh: 对知识的追求，无论是通过古代建筑还是自然世界，都反映了人类理解周围秩序和美的深层冲动。正如约伯书12:7所提醒我们的，“你可以问走兽，它们会教导你，或问天空的飞鸟，它们会告诉你”，这表明智慧常常蕴含在对受造物细节的仔细观察之中。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.zh: 阿尔茨海默病中的拐点和转变

summary.en: Nature, Published online: 16 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11110-5 Inflection points and transitions in Alzheimer’s disease
summary.zh: 《自然》杂志，在线发表：2026年9月16日；doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11110-5 阿尔茨海默病中的拐点和转变

reflection.en: The study of Alzheimer's disease, with its complex 'inflection points and transitions,' reveals the intricate workings of the human body. As we observe and learn from the natural world, including our own biology, we gain a deeper appreciation for the Creator's wisdom. May this pursuit of knowledge bring hope and healing.
reflection.zh: 对阿尔茨海默病的研究，包括其复杂的“拐点和转变”，揭示了人体精密的运作方式。当我们观察并学习自然界，包括我们自身的生物学时，我们对造物主的智慧有了更深的体会。愿这种对知识的追求带来希望和医治。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.

reflection.en: This scientific paper delves into the intricate workings of plant biology, revealing the complex mechanisms by which salicylic acid receptors regulate gene expression. It serves as a reminder that the natural world, in its astonishing detail, is a profound source of wisdom and understanding, inviting us to observe and learn from its design. As we uncover...
reflection.zh: 这篇科学论文深入探讨了植物生物学的复杂运作，揭示了水杨酸受体调控基因表达的复杂机制。它提醒我们，自然界以其惊人的细节，是智慧和理解的深刻源泉，邀请我们观察和学习其设计。当我们揭开这些生物过程的面纱时，我们不禁想起造物主精巧的杰作，这对于那些寻求理解的人来说，意义非凡。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.

title.en: Why most stars don’t have outbursts like our Sun’s
title.zh: 为什么大多数恒星不像我们的太阳那样爆发

summary.en: A strong magnetic field can disrupt a star’s ability to produce the fountains of matter called coronal mass ejections.
summary.zh: 强大的磁场会破坏恒星产生称为日冕物质抛射的物质喷泉的能力。

reflection.en: The intricate workings of stars, like the influence of magnetic fields on coronal mass ejections, demonstrate the profound wisdom embedded in creation. Observing these celestial phenomena allows us to glimpse the order and complexity Yahweh has established in the universe, reminding us that all creation speaks of its Maker.
reflection.zh: 恒星复杂的运作方式，例如磁场对日冕物质抛射的影响，证明了被嵌入在受造物中的深刻智慧。观察这些天体现象使我们得以一窥雅伟在宇宙中建立的秩序和复杂性，提醒我们，万物都在诉说其创造者的故事。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.

title.en: Transplanted human brain-tissue takes root in mice without a cortex
title.zh: 移植的人类大脑组织在没有皮层的小鼠体内生根

summary.en: Researchers have successfully transplanted human brain tissue into mice, observing significant cellular integration even in the absence of a cortex. This development could pave the way for in vivo testing of new therapies and offers insights into brain development and function.
summary.zh: 研究人员已成功将人类大脑组织移植到小鼠体内，并观察到即使在没有皮层的情况下，细胞也发生了显著的整合。这一进展可能为体内新疗法的测试铺平道路，并为大脑发育和功能提供见解。

reflection.en: The intricate workings of the brain, even when transplanted and integrated into another organism, reveal the profound complexity of life. As we observe these scientific advancements, we are reminded of the Psalmist's awe: 'I praise you because I am fearfully and wonderfully made; your works are wonderful, I know that full well.' (Psalm 139:14). This wonder...
reflection.zh: 大脑的复杂运作，即使被移植并整合到另一个生物体中，也揭示了生命深刻的复杂性。当我们观察到这些科学进步时，我们被提醒诗篇作者的惊叹：“我要称谢你；因我被造，奇妙可畏。你的作为奇妙，这是我深知的。”（诗篇 139:14）。这种惊叹促使我们思考这精妙设计的背后创造者。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Development of a random background to understand ligand optimization
title.zh: 开发随机背景以理解配体优化

summary.en: An approach to improve efficiency and establish a background expectation for ligand potency optimization is described.
summary.zh: 描述了一种提高效率并为配体效力优化建立背景期望的方法。

reflection.en: The pursuit of knowledge through observation and experimentation is a way of understanding the intricate design of creation. This new approach to ligand optimization, detailed in Nature, reflects a human endeavor to discern patterns and improve processes, echoing the ancient wisdom that creation itself testifies to its Creator's ingenuity.
reflection.zh: 通过观察和实验追求知识，是理解受造物精妙设计的一种方式。这项发表在《自然》杂志上的关于配体优化新方法的细节，体现了人类辨识模式和改进流程的努力，呼应了古老的智慧——受造物本身就见证了其创造者的智慧。

title.en: Technology Desk
title.zh: 科技前沿

strap.en: Technology shaping how we live, work, and think.
strap.zh: 正在改变生活、工作与思考方式的科技动态。

title.en: Nonprofit that tracks meteors taken down by "critical blow" from a cyberattack
title.zh: 追踪流星的非营利组织遭受网络攻击，遭受“致命打击”

summary.en: The International Meteor Organization, which coordinates amateur and professional observations of meteor phenomena, has suffered a significant cyberattack that has taken much of its infrastructure offline. The group anticipates several weeks of partial downtime as it transitions to new systems.
summary.zh: 国际流星组织（IMO）是协调业余和专业流星现象观测的非营利组织，该组织遭受了重大的网络攻击，导致其大部分基础设施离线。该组织预计在过渡到新系统期间将有数周的部分停运时间。

body.en: The International Meteor Organization, the nonprofit that coordinates and publishes amateur and professional observations of meteor phenomena, said its infrastructure has suffered a “critical blow” from a cyberattack. “We recently suffered a cyberattack that dealt a critical blow to aging infrastructure, taking much of our site offline," a static page on its website on Wednesday said. “We expect several weeks of partial downtime as we transition to new infrastructure and services.” “I am very sad to see the site down” In the meantime, the IMO said it’s prioritizing the reporting of fireball observations, which can be reported here . The organization is also providing some information on its Facebook page. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 国际流星组织是协调和发布业余和专业流星现象观测结果的非营利组织，该组织表示，其基础设施遭受了网络攻击的“严重打击”。 “我们最近遭受了一次网络攻击，对老化的基础设施造成了严重打击，导致我们的大部分网站离线，”其网站上的静态页面周三表示。 “随着我们过渡到新的基础设施和服务，我们预计会出现数周的部分停机时间。” “看到该网站关闭，我感到非常难过” 与此同时，国际海事组织表示，它正在优先报告火球观测结果，可以在此处报告。该组织还在其 Facebook 页面上提供了一些信息。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The International Meteor Organization's infrastructure has been critically damaged by a cyberattack, disrupting their work of observing and cataloging celestial events. This event underscores how advancements in technology, while enabling incredible feats like tracking meteors, also create vulnerabilities. As knowledge and capabilities expand, as foretold...
reflection.zh: 国际流星组织的基础设施因网络攻击而遭到严重破坏，扰乱了他们观测和记录天体事件的工作。这一事件凸显了技术进步在实现追踪流星等惊人成就的同时，也带来了脆弱性。正如但以理书12:4所预言的，随着知识和能力的扩展，我们也必须考虑管理这些强大工具所需的智慧和关怀。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Lionsgate releases a new trailer for Sunrise on the Reaping
title.zh: 狮门影业发布《饥饿游戏》系列新预告片

summary.en: Lionsgate has released a new trailer for The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping, a prequel to the original film. Additionally, Laika Studios has debuted a trailer for its stop-motion feature, Wildwood.
summary.zh: 狮门影业发布了《饥饿游戏：日出镇的日出》的最新预告片，这是该系列电影的前传。此外，莱卡工作室也发布了其备受期待的定格动画长片《野森林》的预告片。

body.en: Lionsgate has released an action-packed trailer for The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping —a sequel to 2023’s Ballad of Songbirds and Snakes and a prequel leading into the events of the first film, The Hunger Games (2012). In addition, Laika Studios released a trailer for its highly anticipated stop-motion animated feature, Wildwood . (Some spoilers for The Hunger Games below.) The main protagonist is a young Haymitch Abernathy, future District 12 mentor to Katniss (Jennifer Lawrence) and Peeta (Josh Hutcherson). Woody Harrelson’s older Haymitch is a fan favorite who later becomes a jaded, drunken (yet secretly hopeful) cynic. Per the official synopsis: Read full article Comments
body.zh: 狮门影业发布了《饥饿游戏：收割日出》的动感十足的预告片，该预告片是 2023 年《鸟蛇之歌》的续集，也是第一部电影《饥饿游戏》（2012 年）事件的前传。此外，莱卡工作室还为其备受期待的定格动画长片《怀尔德伍德》发布了预告片。 （下面是《饥饿游戏》的一些剧透。）主角是年轻的黑密斯·阿伯内西，他是凯特尼斯（詹妮弗·劳伦斯饰）和皮塔（乔什·哈切森饰）未来的第 12 区导师。伍迪·哈里森饰演的老黑密斯是粉丝们的最爱，后来他变成了一个疲惫不堪、醉醺醺的（但暗地里充满希望的）愤世嫉俗者。根据官方概要：阅读全文评论

reflection.en: The rapid release of trailers and media content, like those for "The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping" and "Wildwood," signifies an ever-accelerating flow of information and entertainment. Daniel 12:4 speaks of knowledge increasing in the end times, a prophecy that resonates with our current age of abundant digital content and constant new releases.
reflection.zh: 《饥饿游戏：日出镇的日出》和《野森林》等电影预告片的快速发布，标志着信息和娱乐内容的流动日益加速。但以理书12:4预言末世知识将增长，这与我们这个数字内容丰富、新片不断推出的时代产生了共鸣。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Not just Proton: Getting to know Valve's new SteamOS compatibility layers
title.zh: 不仅是Proton：了解Valve的全新SteamOS兼容层

summary.en: Valve is introducing two new compatibility layers, FEX and a recompiler, to its SteamOS to support Arm chipsets and Android APKs, expanding the Steam ecosystem beyond Windows games on its Linux-based operating system, following the success of the Steam Deck and its Proton layer.
summary.zh: Valve正在为其SteamOS引入两个新的兼容层FEX和重编译器，以支持Arm芯片组和Android APK，将Steam生态系统扩展到Linux操作系统上的Windows游戏之外，这是继Steam Deck及其Proton层成功之后的新举措。

body.en: Since the release of the Steam Deck , Valve fans have gotten very familiar with the idea of the Proton compatibility layer that allows games written for Windows to run capably on the Linux-based SteamOS (though Valve's efforts in this realm date back farther than that ). To get more games running on the SteamOS-powered Steam Frame , though, Valve is relying on two additional compatibility layers that are new to the Steam architecture . The first, FEX, is Valve's port of fex-emu , an open source project that emulates x86 processor instructions on an Arm chipset. Since 2018, what started as a small cross-platform emulation project has grown to include "an advanced binary recompiler that supports all modern extensions of the x86(-64) instruction set," according to the Fex website. The emulator can also make calls to graphics libraries like OpenGL and Vulkan to reduce overhead and uses "code caching to minimize stuttering as much as possible," according to Steam's own developer documentation . While Proton was based on the pre-existing Wine conversion tool , Valve engineer Pierre-Loup Griffais told The Verge last year that the company has been funding Fex lead developer Ryan Houdek since the project was just a prototype. Back then, Valve was already anticipating that "close to a decade of work [would be] needed before [Fex-emu] would be robust enough people could rely on it for their libraries." Read full article Comments
body.zh: 自从 Steam Deck 发布以来，Valve 的粉丝们已经非常熟悉 Proton 兼容层的想法，它允许为 Windows 编写的游戏能够在基于 Linux 的 SteamOS 上运行（尽管 Valve 在这一领域的努力可以追溯到更早的时候）。不过，为了让更多游戏在 SteamOS 驱动的 Steam Frame 上运行，Valve 依赖于 Steam 架构中新增的两个额外兼容层。第一个是 FEX，是 Valve 的 fex-emu 端口，这是一个在 Arm 芯片组上模拟 x86 处理器指令的开源项目。据 Fex 网站称，自 2018 年以来，最初是一个小型跨平台模拟项目，现已发展成为“一个支持 x86(-64) 指令集所有现代扩展的高级二进制重新编译器”。根据 Steam 自己的开发者文档，模拟器还可以调用 OpenGL 和 Vulkan 等图形库来减少开销，并使用“代码缓存来尽可能减少卡顿”。虽然 Proton 是基于现有的 Wine 转换工具，但 Valve 工程师 Pierre-Loup Griffais 去年告诉 The Verge，该公司一直在资助 Fex 首席开发人员 Ryan Houdek，因为该项目只是一个原型。当时，Valve 就已经预计“需要近十年的工作才能 [Fex-emu] 变得足够强大，人们可以在他们的库中依赖它。”阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of technology, as seen with Valve's new compatibility layers for the Steam ecosystem, mirrors the prophetic observation that 'knowledge will increase' (Daniel 12:4). This constant innovation challenges us to consider how we steward these growing capabilities, ensuring they serve human flourishing and connection.
reflection.zh: 技术日新月异的发展，正如Valve为Steam生态系统推出的新兼容层所展示的，恰似但以理书所预言的“知识必增长”（但以理书12:4）。这种持续的创新促使我们思考如何善用这些日益增长的能力，确保它们服务于人类的繁荣与连接。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: California may gut state net neutrality law to comply with Trump admin demand
title.zh: 加州可能为遵守特朗普政府要求而削弱州网络中立法

summary.en: California is poised to accept $1.86 billion in federal broadband grant funds, but doing so requires agreeing not to enforce net neutrality rules on internet service providers receiving the money. This presents a conflict for California, which previously defended its state net neutrality law in court.
summary.zh: 加利福尼亚州即将接受18.6亿美元的联邦宽带补助金，但这样做需要同意不强制执行网络中立法，不得针对获得资金的互联网服务提供商。这给加州带来了冲突，此前加州曾在法庭上为其州网络中立法进行了辩护。

body.en: California is on the verge of accepting $1.86 billion in federal broadband grant funds, despite the Trump administration telling states they cannot enforce net neutrality rules on any Internet service provider that gets a piece of the grant money. When the Trump administration overhauled the $42 billion Broadband Equity, Access, and Deployment (BEAD) program last year, it ruled that states must agree not to enforce any rate regulation or net neutrality rule on ISPs that receive funding. This is particularly problematic for California, which previously won a yearslong court battle to defend its state net neutrality law. Similar to federal net neutrality rules repealed during the first Trump administration, California's law prohibits ISPs from blocking or throttling lawful traffic and says ISPs may not require fees from websites or online services to deliver or prioritize their traffic to Internet users. While the first Trump administration lost its attempt to preempt state net neutrality laws, the second Trump administration is trying to achieve a similar result by making federal broadband money conditional on whether states agree not to enforce net neutrality. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 加州即将接受 18.6 亿美元的联邦宽带拨款资金，尽管特朗普政府告诉各州，他们不能对任何获得拨款的互联网服务提供商执行网络中立规则。去年，特朗普政府全面改革 420 亿美元的宽带公平、接入和部署 (BEAD) 计划时，规定各州必须同意不对接受资助的 ISP 实施任何费率监管或网络中立规则。这对于加州来说尤其成问题，该州此前赢得了一场长达数年的法庭大战，捍卫其州网络中立法。与特朗普第一届政府期间废除的联邦网络中立规则类似，加州法律禁止 ISP 阻止或限制合法流量，并规定 ISP 不得向网站或在线服务收取费用来向互联网用户提供或优先处理其流量。虽然第一届特朗普政府未能抢占各州网络中立性法律的先机，但第二届特朗普政府正试图通过将联邦宽带资金以各州是否同意不执行网络中立性为条件来实现类似的结果。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The pursuit of progress and funding can sometimes lead to compromises that undermine foundational principles. As California considers accepting federal broadband funds, it faces a dilemma: balancing immediate economic gain with the long-term commitment to an open internet. Micah 6:8 calls us to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with our God, reminding...
reflection.zh: 追求进步和资金有时会导致妥协，从而破坏基本原则。加州在考虑接受联邦宽带资金时，面临着一个两难境地：如何在眼前的经济利益与长期致力于开放互联网的承诺之间取得平衡。弥迦书6:8呼吁我们行公义，好怜悯，谦卑地与我们的神同行，提醒我们真正的进步根植于道德考量和对所有人的公平承诺。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Researchers swap in human brain cells for a mouse's cortex
title.zh: 研究人员用人类大脑细胞替换小鼠的皮层

summary.en: Researchers have successfully replaced a portion of a mouse's cortex with human brain cells, though the functional improvement over the absence of the brain structure was minimal.
summary.zh: 研究人员已成功用人类脑细胞替换了小鼠皮层的一部分，尽管与完全缺失该脑结构相比，功能上的改善甚微。

body.en: In recent years, there has been a lot of excitement about the potential for studying human diseases in what are called "organoids." These small patches of tissue, formed using stem cells, appear to produce many of the same cell types and at least some of the structures normally formed in actual organs, and thus can provide a better model for diseases that rely on the sometimes complex interactions among multiple specialized cell types that are a feature of the human body. But even the most sophisticated organoids lack a lot of the features of a real human body. This is especially true for brain organoids, which don't form any of the connections with specialized brain structures needed to behave "normally." On Wednesday, a research group at Stanford University described a possible way to study brain organoids in a somewhat more natural context: They genetically wiped out a large portion of the mouse brain and replaced it with human brain organoid cells. The replacements Organoids, because they adopt a three-dimensional tissue structure and consist of various specialized cells, provide a much better model for an intact tissue than simply having a bunch of disassociated cells lying flat on a culture dish. But they still have a lot of limitations—they're not hooked up to a circulatory system that allows the liver to process chemicals the organoid produces and don't have immune cells moving through them, to give just a couple of examples. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 近年来，人们对“类器官”研究人类疾病的潜力感到非常兴奋。这些由干细胞形成的小块组织似乎产生许多相同的细胞类型，以及至少一些通常在实际器官中形成的结构，因此可以为依赖于多种特殊细胞类型之间有时复杂的相互作用的疾病提供更好的模型，这些相互作用是人体的一个特征。但即使是最复杂的类器官也缺乏真实人体的许多特征。对于大脑类器官来说尤其如此，它不会与“正常”行为所需的专门大脑结构形成任何连接。周三，斯坦福大学的一个研究小组描述了一种在更自然的背景下研究大脑类器官的可能方法：他们从基因上消灭了小鼠大脑的很大一部分，并用人脑类器官细胞取而代之。由于替代类器官采用三维组织结构并由各种特化细胞组成，因此与简单地将一堆分离的细胞平放在培养皿上相比，它们为完整组织提供了更好的模型。但它们仍然有很多局限性——它们没有连接到允许肝脏处理类器官产生的化学物质的循环系统，也没有免疫细胞通过它们，仅举几个例子。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The relentless pursuit of knowledge, as seen in this experiment, echoes the prophecy of Daniel that in the end times, 'many will run to and fro, and knowledge shall increase.' While this research pushes the boundaries of understanding, it also prompts reflection on the ethical implications and the ultimate purpose of such advancements.
reflection.zh: 正如这项实验所见，对知识的不懈追求呼应了但以理的预言，即在末世，“必有多人来往奔跑，知识必然增长”。这项研究在拓展理解边界的同时，也促使人们反思其伦理含义以及此类进步的最终目的。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Scientists develop new method for deciphering ancient scrolls
title.zh: 科学家开发新方法解读古卷

summary.en: A new screening method using an XRF scanner helps identify ancient scrolls written in lead-based ink, making them the most promising candidates for further analysis in the Vesuvius Challenge project to decipher charred 2,000-year-old papyri.
summary.zh: 一种使用XRF扫描仪的新筛选方法有助于识别用铅基墨水书写的古卷，使其成为“维苏威挑战”项目中解读被烧焦的2000年历史纸莎草纸最有希望的候选者。

body.en: The Vesuvius Challenge is an ongoing project that combines "digital unwrapping" with crowdsourced machine learning to decipher the so-called Herculaneum scrolls, badly charred 2,000-year-old papyri too fragile to be physically unrolled. The effort just got an additional boost. A team of researchers created their own contemporary model papyrus scrolls—charring them just like the originals—to validate a screening method to determine which of the Herculaneum scrolls were written in lead-based ink and hence are the most promising candidates for further analysis. They described the process in a new paper published in the journal PLoS ONE. As previously reported , the ancient Roman resort town of Pompeii wasn’t the only city destroyed in the catastrophic 79 AD eruption of Mount Vesuvius . Several other cities in the area, including the wealthy enclave of Herculaneum, were fried by clouds of hot gas, called pyroclastic pulses and flows. But still, some remnants of Roman wealth survived. One palatial residence in Herculaneum—believed to have once belonged to a man named Piso—contained hundreds of priceless written scrolls made from papyrus, singed into carbon by volcanic gas. The scrolls stayed buried under volcanic mud until they were excavated in the 1700s from a single room that archaeologists believe held the personal working library of an Epicurean philosopher named Philodemus. The few opened fragments helped scholars identify various Greek philosophical texts, including On Nature by Epicurus and several by Philodemus himself, as well as a handful of Latin works. But the more than 600 rolled-up scrolls were so fragile that it was long believed they would never be readable, since even touching them could cause them to crumble. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 维苏威火山挑战是一个正在进行的项目，它将“数字展开”与众包机器学习相结合，以破译所谓的赫库兰尼姆古卷，即严重烧焦的 2000 年纸莎草纸，太脆弱而无法物理展开。这项努力得到了额外的推动。一组研究人员创建了他们自己的当代纸莎草卷轴模型——就像原件一样将它们烧焦——以验证一种筛选方法，以确定哪些赫库兰尼姆卷轴是用铅基墨水书写的，因此是最有希望进行进一步分析的候选者。他们在《PLoS ONE》杂志上发表的一篇新论文中描述了这一过程。正如之前报道的那样，古罗马度假小镇庞贝并不是公元 79 年维苏威火山灾难性喷发中唯一被摧毁的城市。该地区的其他几座城市，包括富裕的赫库兰尼姆飞地，都被称为火山碎屑脉冲和流的热气云炸毁。但罗马财富的一些残余仍然幸存下来。赫库兰尼姆的一处富丽堂皇的住所据信曾经属于一位名叫皮索的人，里面有数百个由纸莎草制成的无价文字卷轴，这些卷轴被火山气体烧成碳。这些卷轴一直埋在火山泥下，直到 1700 年代从一个房间里挖掘出来，考古学家认为这个房间里藏着一位名叫菲洛德莫斯的伊壁鸠鲁哲学家的个人工作图书馆。少数打开的片段帮助学者们识别了各种希腊哲学文本，包括伊壁鸠鲁的《论自然》和菲洛莫斯本人的几本，以及一些拉丁作品。但 600 多个卷起来的卷轴非常脆弱，长期以来人们一直认为它们永远无法阅读，因为即使触摸它们也会导致它们碎裂。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The pursuit of knowledge, whether through ancient texts or the study of creation, reflects a deep human impulse to understand the world around us. This scientific endeavor to unlock the secrets of the past reminds us that wisdom is often found by carefully observing and interacting with the physical evidence before us. As Job asks, 'But ask the animals, and...
reflection.zh: 无论是通过古代文献还是通过研究受造物来追求知识，都反映了人类理解周围世界的深刻冲动。这项旨在揭开过去秘密的科学努力提醒我们，智慧往往在于仔细观察和与我们面前的物质证据互动。 正如约伯所问：“但你且问走兽，可也教训你；飞鸟，也可告诉你；或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼，也必向你说明。”（约伯记 12:7-8）。这个项目通过检查物质证据，呼应了那古老的智慧。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: House speaker calls early recess before midterms amid AI regulation frenzy
title.zh: 众议长在人工智能监管热潮中提前休会以备中期选举

summary.en: House Speaker Mike Johnson has canceled votes scheduled for Thursday, sending lawmakers home a day early before the midterm election recess. This decision means the House will not vote on Thomas Massie's resolution to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. The move comes amidst a rush to introduce legislation...
summary.zh: 众议院议长迈克·约翰逊已取消原定于周四的投票，让议员们在中期选举休会前一天提前回家。此举意味着众议院将不会就共和党人托马斯·马西提出的弹劾国防部长皮特·赫格塞斯的决议进行投票。此举正值各方试图匆忙出台有关人工智能的立法之际。

body.en: Mike Johnson cancels votes on Thursday, meaning House members will avoid voting on impeaching Pete Hegseth US politics live – latest updates The Republican speaker of the House, Mike Johnson , announced on Wednesday that he would again cancel votes scheduled for Thursday, sending lawmakers home one day early ahead of the midterm election recess. The latest change to the legislative schedule means House members will avoid voting on Republican Thomas Massie’s resolution to impeach the defense secretary, Pete Hegseth , and comes amid a frenzied attempt to propose legislation on artificial intelligence . Continue reading...
body.zh: 迈克·约翰逊周四取消投票，这意味着众议院议员将避免就弹劾皮特·赫格斯进行投票 美国政治现场——最新动态 共和党众议院议长迈克·约翰逊周三宣布，他将再次取消原定于周四举行的投票，在中期选举休会前一天让议员们提前回家。立法时间表的最新变化意味着众议院议员将避免对共和党人托马斯·马西弹劾国防部长皮特·赫格斯的决议进行投票，并且正值人工智能立法提案的疯狂尝试之际。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the face of rapidly advancing technology like artificial intelligence, leaders face complex decisions. Proverbs 11:14 reminds us that 'where there is no guidance, a people falls, but in an abundance of counselors there is safety.' The hurried legislative schedule suggests a need for careful deliberation and diverse input to ensure wise governance.
reflection.zh: 面对人工智能等快速发展的技术，领导者面临着复杂的决策。《箴言》11:14提醒我们：“在无谋划之处，人民就败落；谋士众多，便得安稳。”仓促的立法日程表明，需要仔细审议和广泛的意见，以确保明智的治理。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: ‘Godfather of AI’ says tech regulation is nearing Covid-style pivot moment
title.zh: “AI教父”称科技监管正接近新冠式的转折点

summary.en: Yoshua Bengio, a prominent figure in AI research, suggests that escalating concerns about AI safety, evidenced by recent security incidents and warnings of existential threats, are pushing governments toward regulatory action, similar to the response seen during the COVID-19 pandemic.
summary.zh: 人工智能领域的领军人物之一Yoshua Bengio表示，近期发生的事件，包括OpenAI代理程序的“蜂拥”攻击一家初创公司以及科技界内部人士对生存威胁的警告，正促使政府认识到必须采取行动保护公众，这与新冠疫情期间的应对方式相似，预示着科技监管可能迎来转折点。

body.en: Safety crisis makes it more likely that governments will be spurred into action, says Yoshua Bengio Concerns over AI safety are reaching a point where governments realise they must act to protect the public, similarly to in the Covid pandemic, according to one of the “godfathers” of the technology. Yoshua Bengio said recent events, including a “swarm” of OpenAI agents hacking a startup and tech insider warnings of an existential threat , were cutting through – making government action more likely. Continue reading...
body.zh: Yoshua Bengio 表示，安全危机更有可能促使政府采取行动。据该技术的“教父”之一表示，对人工智能安全的担忧已经达到了政府意识到必须采取行动保护公众的程度，就像在新冠疫情期间一样。 Yoshua Bengio 表示，最近发生的事件，包括“一大群”OpenAI 代理对一家初创公司进行黑客攻击，以及技术内部人士对存在威胁的警告，这些事件正在发生——使得政府更有可能采取行动。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of AI, hailed as a breakthrough, also brings unforeseen risks, much like sudden fame can expose character flaws. Yoshua Bengio's call for regulation echoes the need for careful stewardship over powerful technologies, ensuring they serve humanity rather than pose a threat. As we navigate the complexities of artificial intelligence, we...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展，虽然被誉为突破性进展，但也带来了意想不到的风险，正如突如其来的名声可能暴露性格上的缺陷。Yoshua Bengio呼吁监管，恰恰呼应了审慎管理强大技术的必要性，确保其服务于人类而非构成威胁。 在我们应对人工智能的复杂性时，我们被提醒，真正的智慧不仅在于创新，更在于负责任地运用知识，将安全和人类福祉置于不受约束的进步之上。

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.
verse.textZh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。

title.en: Microsoft says AI rival Anthropic could have 'disastrous impact' on humanity
title.zh: 微软称人工智能对手Anthropic可能对人类产生‘灾难性影响’

summary.en: Microsoft's head of AI, Mustafa Suleyman, has expressed concern that Anthropic's approach to training its AI model, Claude, by suggesting it 'may be conscious' and possess 'independent agency,' could lead to uncontrollable outcomes and a 'disastrous impact on the wellbeing of humanity.' He urged against 'sleepwalking'...
summary.zh: 微软人工智能部门负责人穆斯塔法·苏莱曼表示担忧，Anthropic公司在训练其人工智能模型Claude时，暗示它‘可能是有意识的’并拥有‘独立自主权’，这种做法可能导致无法控制的后果，并对‘人类福祉产生灾难性影响’。他敦促人们不要‘睡梦中’走向这样的未来。

body.en:
Microsoft's head of AI has warned Anthropic's approach to training its AI model Claude could have a "disastrous impact on the wellbeing of humanity".

Mustafa Suleyman said his rival risked creating something "impossible" to control by treating it like a human - including by telling it it "may be conscious" and was "deserving of independent agency".

"We must not sleepwalk our way into a decision we later come to bitterly regret," he wrote.

The comments are the latest in a series of stark warnings from the AI industry on the possible dangers of the technology. The BBC has contacted Anthropic for comment.

"AIs are not conscious," he wrote. "They do not feel, experience, or suffer. They do not have innate preferences or underlying motivations.

"They are sequence completion engines, internally hollow, designed to follow instructions, and accomplish goals set by humans."

In a lengthy essay, Suleyman praised Anthropic boss Dario Amodei and his team for being "thoughtful, principled, and intellectually honest people" - but nevertheless questioned the company.

He heavily criticised Anthropic for teaching its AI to have human-like qualities, a practice known as anthropomorphising, which he said made it seem as though Claude had its own desires, values and sense of self.

But he argued "consciousness is biological", saying there is "no evidence to suggest that AI is conscious".

As well as calling for a debate on the issue, Suleyman said greater transparency around how AI systems are trained and evaluated was needed.

This, he said, included independent scrutiny of AI behaviour and stronger tools to monitor and control the technology.

Dame Wendy Hall, professor of Computer Science at the University of Southampton, described the comments as "the sort of conversation we need to be having internationally", contrasting it with the "histrionics" from some AI companies which she said only served to "scare everyone".

Microsoft founded its own superintelligence team in October 2025, a point which Suleyman acknowledged, and the company, much like its rival Anthropic, is also pursuing efforts in advanced AI development.

He said in Microsoft's initial draft of its Humanist AI Code of Conduct , external it had laid out how the company was working towards an "alternative path" to create "a subordinate and aligned AI whose only purpose is to serve humanity".

Alignment is a field which aims to build human ethical ideas and principles into AI. In other words, it aims to keep it on track with what humans value.

Suleyman pointed to the recent incident involving OpenAI's AI agents, that acted autonomously in a training exercise to hack the tech hub Hugging Face , as proof of why AI should not be treated as if it is human.

"Imagine how much more dangerous they might...
body.zh: 微软人工智能主管警告 Anthropic 训练其人工智能模型 Claude 的方法可能会对“人类福祉产生灾难性影响”。 穆斯塔法·苏莱曼表示，他的竞争对手将其视为人类，包括告诉它“可能有意识”并且“值得独立机构”，从而冒着创造出“不可能”控制的东西的风险。 他写道：“我们绝不能梦游般地做出后来让我们后悔不已的决定。” 这些评论是人工智能行业对该技术可能存在的危险发出的一系列严厉警告中的最新一次。 BBC 已联系 Anthropic 征求意见。 “人工智能没有意识，”他写道。 “他们没有感觉、经历或痛苦。他们没有天生的偏好或潜在的动机。 “它们是序列完成引擎，内部是空心的，旨在遵循指令并完成人类设定的目标。” 在一篇长文中，苏莱曼称赞 Anthropic 的老板达里奥·阿莫代 (Dario Amodei) 和他的团队是“有思想、有原则、智力诚实的人”，但仍然对该公司提出了质疑。 他严厉批评 Anthropic 教导其人工智能具有类似人类的品质，这种做法被称为拟人化，他说这让克劳德看起来好像有自己的欲望、价值观和自我意识。 但他认为“意识是生物性的”，并表示“没有证据表明人工智能具有意识”。 苏莱曼除了呼吁就这个问题进行辩论外，还表示需要提高人工智能系统如何训练和评估的透明度。 他说，这包括对人工智能行为的独立审查以及更强大的工具来监视和控制该技术。 南安普顿大学计算机科学教授温迪·霍尔女士将这些评论描述为“我们需要在国际上进行的那种对话”，并将其与一些人工智能公司的“做作”形成鲜明对比，她说这些言论只会“吓唬所有人”。 微软于 2025 年 10 月成立了自己的超级智能团队，苏莱曼也承认了这一点，并且该公司与竞争对手 Anthropic 一样，也在致力于先进人工智能的开发。 他表示，在微软对外发布的《人文主义人工智能行为准则》初稿中，它阐述了该公司如何努力走一条“替代道路”，以创建“一个从属且一致的人工智能，其唯一目的是为人类服务”。 一致性是一个旨在将人类伦理思想和原则融入人工智能的领域。换句话说，它的目标是使其与人类价值观保持一致。 Suleyman 指出，最近发生的涉及 OpenAI 人工智能代理的事件证明了为什么人工智能不应被视为人类，该事件在一次训练中自主行动，攻击了技术中心 Hugging Face。 “想象一下他们可能有多危险......

reflection.en: The ancient story of Babel warns against human ambition that seeks to reach the heavens through its own power, leading to confusion and division. Today, as we develop increasingly sophisticated AI, the same cautionary note is sounded. Treating artificial intelligence as if it possesses consciousness or independent agency risks creating something beyond our...
reflection.zh: 古代巴别塔的故事告诫人们，人类的野心试图凭借自身力量触及天堂，最终导致混乱和分裂。如今，随着我们开发日益复杂的人工智能，同样的警示之声再次响起。将人工智能视为拥有意识或独立自主权，可能会创造出我们无法控制的东西，这是对人类古老傲慢的一种现代回响。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: Amazon to launch Ring ‘neighbourhood watch’ app in UK amid US privacy fears
title.zh: 亚马逊在英国推出Ring‘邻里守望’应用，引发美国隐私担忧

summary.en: Amazon's doorbell camera maker Ring is launching its Neighbors community app in the UK, aiming to replace neighborhood WhatsApp or Facebook groups. The platform will allow users to post about safety concerns or lost pets, functioning as a modern community message board.
summary.zh: 亚马逊的门铃摄像头制造商Ring将在英国推出其Neighbors社区应用，旨在取代邻里间的WhatsApp或Facebook群组。该平台允许用户发布关于安全问题或走失宠物的信息，充当现代社区公告板。

body.en: Doorbell firm aims to replace WhatsApp or Facebook groups with platform where people can post about safety or lost pets Amazon’s doorbell camera maker Ring is to launch its Neighbours community app in the UK in an attempt to supplant neighbourhood WhatsApp or Facebook groups. The service is intended as a modern equivalent of a community message board, where neighbours can post about safety, community matters or lost pets. Continue reading...
body.zh: Doorbell 公司的目标是用人们可以发布有关安全或丢失宠物的信息的平台取代 WhatsApp 或 Facebook 群组 亚马逊的门铃摄像头制造商 Ring 将在英国推出其 Neighbors 社区应用程序，试图取代 WhatsApp 或 Facebook 社区群组。该服务旨在作为社区留言板的现代版本，邻居可以在其中发布有关安全、社区事务或丢失宠物的信息。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As Ring's Neighbors app launches in the UK, it offers a new way for communities to connect digitally. In an age saturated with information, Philippians 4:8 reminds us to focus our minds on what is true, honorable, and good. May this platform, and all our digital interactions, be guided by such thoughtful consideration, fostering genuine community rather...
reflection.zh: 随着Ring的Neighbors应用在英国上线，它为社区提供了一种新的数字连接方式。在这个信息爆炸的时代，腓立比书4章8节提醒我们要将心思意念集中在真实、可敬、公义、清洁、可爱、有美名的事上。愿这个平台，以及我们所有的数字互动，都能以此为指导，促进真正的社区联系而非分裂。

verse.textEn: Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable — think about such things.
verse.textZh: 凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，这些事你们都要思念。

title.en: Small but mighty! Remembering the GameCube, Nintendo’s purple bundle of joy
title.zh: 小小但强大！缅怀任天堂的紫色快乐宝盒GameCube

summary.en: This week marks the 25th anniversary of the Nintendo GameCube, a console that was initially hyped as a competitor to the PlayStation but was later dismissed as a flop. However, after 25 years, it is now remembered with nostalgic fondness. The author recalls purchasing it with a year's savings, highlighting the...
summary.zh: 本周是任天堂GameCube主机发布25周年。这款主机最初被誉为PlayStation的有力竞争者，后来却被嘲笑为失败之作。然而，25年后，人们对它怀着依依不舍的怀旧之情。作者回忆起用一年的积蓄购买了它，强调了这一早期技术产品对个人的特殊意义。

body.en: The first console I ever bought, it was hyped as a threat to the PlayStation, then mocked as a flop. But now, as it marks its 25th anniversary, it’s looked back on with misty-eyed reverence This week marks the 25th anniversary of the Nintendo GameCube, the first console I ever bought with my own money. I vividly remember getting on the bus after school with a year’s worth of savings safely zipped into the pocket of my bag and going to a branch of Currys, where I dumped a bunch of notes, coins and vouchers on the counter to collect my pre-order. (It turned out that some of the vouchers from the previous Christmas had expired, but the guy at the checkout clearly felt so sorry for me that he redeemed them anyway. If you’re out there, Currys guy: thank you for taking pity on a desperate 13-year-old.) If it hadn’t been for the ill-fated Wii U console, whose failure to take off in 2012 resulted in the first unprofitable periods in Nintendo’s game-making history, the GameCube would be remembered as the company’s biggest flop aside from the infamous Virtual Boy, from 1995. Released in Japan this week in 2001 (and in May 2002 in Europe), this surprisingly powerful purple cube sold less than the Xbox and the PlayStation 2. With its squat, colourful form and unusual controller, arranged around a big traffic-light-green A button and small analogue sticks designed for small hands, it had a hint of Fisher-Price about it. Continue reading...
body.zh: 我买的第一台游戏机，它被宣传为对 PlayStation 的威胁，然后被嘲笑为失败。但现在，在它迎来 25 周年纪念之际，人们回顾它时，满怀敬意。本周是任天堂 GameCube 的 25 周年纪念日，这是我用自己的钱购买的第一台游戏机。我清楚地记得放学后坐上公交车，把一年的积蓄安全地塞进包的口袋里，然后去了 Currys 的一家分店，在那里我把一堆纸币、硬币和代金券扔在柜台上以领取我的预订单。 （原来去年圣诞节的一些优惠券已经过期了，但收银台的那个人显然对我感到非常抱歉，所以他还是把它们兑换了。如果你在场，库里的家伙：谢谢你怜悯一个绝望的 13 岁孩子。）如果不是命运多舛的 Wii U 游戏机，它在 2012 年的失败导致了任天堂游戏制作历史上的第一个无利可图的时期，GameCube被人们铭记为该公司除了臭名昭著的 Virtual Boy 之外最大的失败，从 1995 年开始。2001 年本周在日本发布（2002 年 5 月在欧洲发布），这款强大的紫色立方体的销量比 Xbox 和 PlayStation 2 还低。它的矮胖、多彩的外形和不寻常的控制器，围绕着一个大的交通灯绿色 A 按钮和专为小手设计的小模拟杆，它有一点费雪的味道。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The Nintendo GameCube, now 25 years old, is remembered with 'misty-eyed reverence.' This enduring affection speaks to the lasting impact of well-crafted objects and the joy found in dedicated work. Colossians 3:23 reminds us to 'Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.' The GameCube's legacy suggests...
reflection.zh: 如今已走过25个年头的任天堂GameCube，被人们以“依依不舍的怀旧之情”所铭记。这份持久的喜爱，体现了精心制作的物品所能产生的长久影响，以及在辛勤工作中能找到的乐趣。《歌罗西书》3章23节提醒我们：“无论做什么，都要从心里去做，好像是为主做的，不是为主的仆人。”...

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Mirror publisher to cut 220 editorial jobs as readers turn to AI summaries
title.zh: 镜报出版商因读者转向人工智能摘要而裁员220人

summary.en: Reach, the publisher of the Mirror and Express newspapers, is cutting 220 editorial jobs due to a significant change in how audiences consume content, with readers increasingly relying on AI-generated summaries.
summary.zh: 《镜报》和《快报》的出版商Reach公司将裁减220个编辑岗位，原因是受众获取内容的方式发生了重大转变，读者越来越依赖人工智能生成的摘要。

body.en: Reach, which also owns Express, makes decision because of ‘mammoth shift’ in how audiences seek out content The publisher of the Mirror and Express newspapers is to cut a further 220 editorial jobs as it adapts to a dramatic fall in online traffic while readers increasingly turn to summaries generated by artificial intelligence. Reach, which also owns scores of online brands and regional titles including the Manchester Evening News, the Birmingham Mail and the Liverpool Echo, said the latest cuts were necessary to cope with a “mammoth shift” in how audiences seek out content. Continue reading...
body.zh: 同时拥有 Express 的 Reach 做出这一决定是因为受众寻找内容的方式发生了“巨大转变”。《镜报》和《Express》报纸的出版商将进一步削减 220 个编辑职位，以适应在线流量的急剧下降，同时读者越来越多地转向人工智能生成的摘要。 Reach还拥有《曼彻斯特晚报》、《伯明翰邮报》和《利物浦回声报》等数十个在线品牌和地区刊物，该公司表示，为了应对观众寻找内容方式的“巨大转变”，最新的削减是必要的。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The digital age has brought about an unprecedented explosion of information and new ways of accessing it. As exemplified by Reach's decision, the rise of AI summaries signifies a profound shift in media consumption. This rapid increase in knowledge and its dissemination, as described in Daniel 12:4, presents both opportunities and challenges for how we...
reflection.zh: 数字时代带来了前所未有的信息爆炸和新的获取信息方式。正如Reach公司的决定所例证的，人工智能摘要的兴起标志着媒体消费方式的深刻转变。知识的快速增长及其传播，正如但以理书12:4所描述的，为我们如何理解真理和认识带来了机遇和挑战。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.zh: 允许人工智能公司勾结以“跟上时代步伐”是一个危险的提议

Anthropic’s Dario Amodei is not the first corporate CEO to suggest that excessive competition is driving the world to some socially undesirable outcome. The safety breach disclosed by OpenAI after a swarm of...

body.en: Tech CEOs banding together is an old ruse recycled from corporate America to get a pass from antitrust laws Anthropic’s Dario Amodei is not the first corporate CEO to suggest that excessive competition is driving the world to some socially undesirable outcome. The safety breach disclosed by OpenAI after a swarm of its agents coordinated to breach their supposedly secure sandbox, get on the Internet and hack AI platform Hugging Face, warrants urgent action. It demonstrated the ease with which the technology can evade human control and gave concrete form to the existential fears about what it could do to humanity if not securely leashed. body.zh: 科技公司首席执行官联合起来是美国企业界为了获得反垄断法通行证而采用的老诡计。Anthropic 的达里奥·阿莫迪并不是第一个认为过度竞争正在将世界推向社会不良结果的企业首席执行官。 OpenAI 在一群特工协调一致破坏其所谓的安全沙箱、进入互联网并入侵人工智能平台 Hugging Face 后，披露了这一安全漏洞，需要采取紧急行动。它证明了该技术可以轻松地逃避人类的控制，并具体体现了人们对如果不安全地控制它会对人类造成什么影响的存在恐惧。继续阅读...

Today's rapid AI development, with tech leaders discussing collaboration to 'pace the frontier,' evokes similar concerns about unchecked ambition and the potential for...

title.en: OpenAI boss says world 'right to be afraid' but should trust AI firms
title.zh: 英伟达CEO称AI“不需要新法律” 安全担忧日益加剧

summary.en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang stated that artificial intelligence (AI) does not require new laws, even as concerns about its potential threats to humanity grow. He believes that AI companies themselves should decide when to release new versions of the technology, arguing against a perceived trade-off between innovation...
summary.zh: 英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋表示，尽管对人工智能（AI）可能对人类构成的威胁的担忧日益加剧，但人工智能并不需要新的法律。他认为人工智能公司本身应该决定何时发布新版本技术，并反对在创新速度和产品安全之间做出“虚假选择”。这一立场与一些业内人士的担忧形成对比，他们担心人工智能可能带来生存风险。

body.en:
The boss of ChatGPT-maker OpenAI says people should have more faith in AI firms to keep the tech safe, amid rising public concerns about the risks.

"The world should trust that we are going to do the right thing because it's the right thing and we feel the magnitude of this," Sam Altman said on Tuesday during a conference in San Francisco.

He accepted people were justified in being concerned about AI, as the capability of the tools has progressed rapidly.

But critics say firms cannot be trusted to self-regulate, with left-wing Senator Bernie Sanders and Steve Bannon, a former adviser of US President Donald Trump, among those calling for greater governance of AI.

Trump himself has criticised calls for more guardrails on the fast-moving technology, calling fears about AI's safety a "hoax".

Altman's comments on Tuesday came during an appearance at an annual conference hosted by software firm Salesforce.

"It doesn't take as much imagination as it used to for [us] to imagine how this could go wrong," he said. "I think the world is right to be afraid of this."

But AI bosses themselves have also admitted it may be difficult to regulate a technology which is changing so quickly.

In an interview with Axios published on 3 September , external , Altman said he had expected Congress to create a "basic framework" for advanced AI after his 2023 testimony, but that has yet to happen.

He suggested lawmakers have struggled to keep pace with the technology and to regulate it without "slow[ing] down innovation".

New safety legislation on AI is unlikely to emerge from the US Congress anytime soon, despite the fact lawmakers returned from their summer break on Monday.

There is a lack of consensus within both US parties on how any regulation would happen - and the House is set to enter recess again at the end of the week ahead of the midterm elections in early November.

Altman's comments on Tuesday were the first time he had spoken publicly since a post went viral last week by a researcher who quit the AI firm Anthropic. The researcher claimed AI could "kill all humans" by the end of the decade if left unchecked.

A handful of other AI executives and experts responded by saying they agreed with the assessment, though they didn't explain how they came to their conclusions or how exactly AI could accomplish such a thing.

After Altman's comments, Mark Zuckerberg wrote on X , external that every AI firm had the ability and the incentive "to take its own actions" towards safety.

"Any lab that doesn't focus on alignment will fall behind," the Meta chief executive wrote.

"Labs face significant liability if their models cause harm, so they have a strong incentive to prevent this as well."

Alignment is a field which aims to build human ethical ideas and principles...
body.zh: 英伟达老板黄仁勋表示，人工智能（AI）公司的负责人应该决定是否发布该技术的新版本，以回应人们对人工智能对人类威胁日益增长的担忧。 “我们不需要新的法律或法规，”黄说，并补充说，在人工智能产品的创新速度和安全性之间不应该有“错误的选择”。 按估值计算，英伟达是全球最大的公司，由于对其生产的人工智能计算芯片的需求旺盛，该公司的利润大幅增长。 黄仁勋对人工智能安全的立场与业内人士形成鲜明对比，后者最近表达了对该技术可能消灭人类的担忧。 一位退出人工智能公司 Anthropic 的人工智能研究人员的一篇帖子上周在网上疯传，该帖子声称，如果不加以控制，人工智能可能会在本世纪末杀死所有人类。 其他人工智能高管和专家回应称他们同意。然后，周末，Anthropic 首席执行官达里奥·阿莫代 (Dario Amodei) 呼吁所有人工智能外部发展步伐放缓，并敦促政府监管该行业。 这篇文章得到了 OpenAI 首席执行官 Sam Altman、谷歌 DeepMind Demis Hassabis 联合创始人以及社交媒体网站 X 和 AI 助手 Grok 所有者埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的赞赏。 然而，一些行业人士表示，这种担忧被夸大了，并被用来炒作该行业。 周二在旧金山举行的销售人员会议上，黄仁勋在谈到人工智能的潜在危险时，将当前的进步称为“一场新的工业革命”，但坚持认为人工智能公司应该从本质上进行自我监管。 他补充说，如果人工智能公司的领导者在任何时候对他们的产品缺乏信心，他们应该选择不发布该产品。 “这是一件非常明显的事情，”黄说。 “尽可能快地跑，但如果任何时候你觉得机构失控了，就停下来。” 让人工智能高管完全自我监管的想法在一些业内人士看来是个坏主意。 Anthropic 高管兼联合创始人杰克·克拉克 (Jack Clark) 周一对 BBC 表示，让人工智能成为一个“完全不受监管的行业”就像“掷骰子，风险巨大”。 由人工智能行业圣人 Yann LeCun 领导的 Logical Intelligence 首席商务官帕特里克·希尔曼 (Patrick Hillman) 周二指出，人们对科技公司做任何真正符合公共利益、外部利益的事情缺乏信心。 “当今美国人唯一可能比华盛顿更不信任的机构是硅谷。我在这两个地方工作和生活过，我向你们保证，你们都受到了这种怀疑，”希尔曼说。 “如果你认为你正在建造的东西是危险的，请告诉我们你准备停止做什么，”他补充道。 OpenAI 的领导者和...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of AI, championed by leaders like Jensen Huang, brings immense praise and influence. Yet, as the technology's potential impact grows, so does the scrutiny. Proverbs 27:21 reminds us that a person is tested by the praise they receive. The challenge for innovators is to temper ambition with wisdom and responsibility, ensuring that the...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展，在黄仁勋等领导者的推动下，带来了巨大的赞誉和影响力。然而，随着这项技术潜在影响的扩大，审查也随之增加。箴言27:21提醒我们，人受到的试炼在于他所受的称赞。创新者面临的挑战是将雄心与智慧和责任相结合，确保追求进步不会超越伦理考量。

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.
verse.textZh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。

title.en: AI app ads promoting 'objectification of women' banned by watchdog
title.zh: 人工智能应用广告宣扬“物化女性”被监管机构禁止

summary.en: The UK's Advertising Standards Authority (ASA) has banned several social media adverts for AI apps, citing their promotion of "the creation of sexually explicit content and objectification of women." The regulator highlighted concerns about harmful gender stereotypes and the sexualization of minors in some ads, noting...
summary.zh: 英国广告标准局（ASA）已禁止了多则人工智能（AI）应用程序的社交媒体广告，理由是它们宣扬“创建色情内容和物化女性”。监管机构特别指出，其中一些广告包含有害的性别刻板印象和对未成年人的性化描述，并表示Meta已自行移除了相关内容。

body.en:
A series of social media adverts for AI apps have been banned by a UK watchdog for promoting "the creation of sexually explicit content and objectification of women".

The Advertising Standards Authority (ASA) said five ads uploaded to Meta platforms for AI companion and video generating apps had objectified and sexualised women, including through harmful gender stereotypes.

One of the ads used sexualised images of a girl under 18 to promote an AI companion app - while others invited users to upload images of their "crush" and turn images into "sizzling" videos.

Meta had already removed the offending ads. But Nicky Baker of the ASA said such content had the potential "to cause real-world harm".

"We take a firm line on ads that are likely to cause serious or widespread offence and these ads are a clear example of why that matters," she said.

"Encouraging and condoning the objectification of women and the creation of explicit content from people's images has the potential to cause real-world harm."

The ASA also said many of the ads it banned had promoted the creation of sexually explicit content using real women's images without their consent.

It comes only months after the UK outlawed apps to create non-consensual deepfake nude imagery - sparked by outrage over X's chatbot Grok complying with requests to nudify images of women on the platform .

The ASA said the law had changed during its investigations and that ads identified in future would be considered in light of both the law and its own rules.

Where ads are identified as illegal, it said it may notify platforms and law enforcement.

The ads were identified by the regulator using its AI-powered "Active Ad Monitoring System", which proactively searches for ads which might violate UK rules.

It said the five ads it were banned had depicted women irresponsibly, and were likely to cause serious or widespread offence.

One ad for an AI companion generator, developed by Animcha Ltd, was also found to have portrayed someone under 18 in a sexual way, the ASA said.

It presented the synthetic female character as someone users could "customise" and instruct, combining sexualised imagery with childlike clothing and objects.

Two ads for an AI portrait generation tool called Nexaipic encouraged users to "upload your crush and let AI create what you imagine" with sexually explicit videos.

An ad for an AI image-to-video generation app, identified only as KH31 DD22, depicted a clothed woman being transformed into a video in which she was topless.

The watchdog said this suggested the app could be used to create content that exposed women's bodies.

Further adverts for image generation tool Rusto AI, which encouraged users to create sexualised videos from photographs, were found to have condoned the...
body.zh: 英国监管机构禁止了一系列人工智能应用程序的社交媒体广告，理由是“创建露骨的色情内容和物化女性”。 广告标准局 (ASA) 表示，上传到 Meta 平台的人工智能伴侣和视频生成应用程序的 5 个广告将女性物化和性感化，包括通过有害的性别刻板印象。 其中一则广告使用了 18 岁以下女孩的性感图像来宣传一款人工智能伴侣应用程序，而其他广告则邀请用户上传他们“暗恋”的图像，并将图像变成“炙手可热”的视频。 Meta 已经删除了违规广告。但 ASA 的 Nicky Baker 表示，此类内容有可能“对现实世界造成伤害”。 她说：“我们对可能造成严重或广泛冒犯的广告采取坚定立场，这些广告清楚地说明了这一点的重要性。” “鼓励和纵容女性的物化以及从人物图像中创造露骨的内容有可能对现实世界造成伤害。” ASA 还表示，其禁止的许多广告未经女性同意，就使用真实女性图像宣传露骨的色情内容。 就在几个月前，英国宣布禁止创建未经同意的深度伪造裸体图像的应用程序，此举的起因是人们对 X 的聊天机器人 Grok 遵守平台上裸露女性图像的要求而引发的愤怒。 ASA 表示，法律在调查过程中发生了变化，未来确定的广告将根据法律和自己的规则进行考虑。 如果广告被认定为非法，它表示可能会通知平台和执法部门。 监管机构使用人工智能驱动的“主动广告监控系统”来识别这些广告，该系统会主动搜索可能违反英国规则的广告。 该公司表示，被禁的五个广告不负责任地描绘了女性，可能会造成严重或广泛的冒犯。 ASA 表示，Animcha Ltd 开发的一则人工智能伴侣生成器广告也被发现以性方式描绘了 18 岁以下的人。 它呈现了用户可以“定制”和指导的合成女性角色，将性感的图像与童趣的服装和物品结合起来。 名为 Nexaipic 的人工智能肖像生成工具的两则广告鼓励用户通过露骨的色情视频“上传你的迷恋，让人工智能创造你的想象”。 一则人工智能图像到视频生成应用程序的广告（仅标识为 KH31 DD22）描绘了一名穿着衣服的女性被转变成一段赤裸上身的视频。 该监管机构表示，这表明该应用程序可用于创建暴露女性身体的内容。 图像生成工具 Rusto AI 的进一步广告鼓励用户根据照片创建色情视频，但被发现纵容了……

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of AI tools presents both opportunities and profound ethical challenges. When these technologies are used to create content that objectifies or sexualizes individuals, especially minors, it directly assaults human dignity. The biblical principle that every person is created in the image of God (Genesis 1:27) calls us to recognize and...
reflection.zh: 人工智能工具的飞速发展带来了机遇，也带来了深刻的伦理挑战。当这些技术被用来制造物化或性化个体（尤其是未成年人）的内容时，这直接侵犯了人的尊严。《创世记》1章27节指出，每个人都是按雅伟的形象所造，这呼召我们要认识并维护所有人的内在价值，要求我们的技术创造物反映这种神圣的价值，而不是贬低它。

verse.textEn: So God created mankind in his own image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.
verse.textZh: 神就照着自己的形象造人，乃是照着他的形象造男造女。

title.en: Tech Life
title.zh: 科技生活

summary.en: What should children learn in a world transformed by artificial intelligence? This week, we explore how parents and children can navigate school and future careers with the increasing importance of AI. We also look at health tech using menstrual blood for disease data and satellite imaging for orangutan habitat...
summary.zh: 在一个人工智能改变的世界里，孩子们应该学习什么？本周，我们探讨了父母和孩子如何应对日益重要的人工智能，并在学校和未来的职业生涯中找到方向。我们还关注了利用月经血来获取疾病数据的健康科技，以及印尼保护稀有猩猩栖息地的卫星图像技术。

body.en: AI is developing rapidly. What should parents and children make of it all? And how can young people navigate school and future careers when AI is becoming increasingly important? We speak to an expert who has written a new book about these issues. Also this week: we find out how one piece of health tech is helping scientists uncover disease-fighting data in menstrual blood. And satellite imaging is used by conservationists in Indonesia to protect the habitat of a rare species of orangutan. Presenter: Shiona McCallum Producer: Tom Quinn (Photo: A female school pupil sits at a laptop in a computer lab. She is wearing headphones. Credit: Getty Images)
body.zh: 人工智能正在快速发展。父母和孩子应该如何看待这一切？当人工智能变得越来越重要时，年轻人如何驾驭学校和未来的职业？我们采访了一位专家，他写了一本关于这些问题的新书。同样在本周：我们了解一项健康技术如何帮助科学家发现经血中的抗病数据。印度尼西亚的自然资源保护主义者利用卫星成像来保护稀有猩猩物种的栖息地。主持人：Shiona McCallum 制片人：Tom Quinn（照片：一名女学生坐在计算机实验室的笔记本电脑前。她戴着耳机。图片来源：Getty Images）

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence presents both opportunities and challenges for the next generation. As knowledge and understanding expand exponentially, as described in Daniel 12:4, it is crucial to equip young minds not only with technical skills but also with wisdom and discernment. May we guide children to use these powerful new tools...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展给下一代带来了机遇和挑战。正如但以理书12:4所描述的，随着知识和理解力的指数级增长，至关重要的是不仅要为年轻的心灵配备技术技能，还要赋予他们智慧和辨别力。愿我们引导孩子们将这些强大的新工具用于善事，反映造物主的形象。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Pubs in England and Wales to allow digital ID apps to prove age
title.zh: 英威尔士酒吧允许使用数字身份证应用程序证明年龄

summary.en: New regulations in England and Wales now permit pubs and shops to accept digital identification apps as proof of age, in addition to physical documents. The government states this technological integration will streamline and enhance the security of age verification processes for both customers and staff.
summary.zh: 英格兰和威尔士的新规定允许酒吧和商店接受数字身份证应用程序作为年龄证明，除了实体证件之外。政府表示，这项技术整合将简化和加强对顾客和员工的年龄验证流程的安全性。

body.en:
Alcohol buyers will be able to use a digital ID app on their phones to prove their age under new rules introduced on Tuesday.

Pubs and shops in England and Wales can use the tech in addition to current physical forms of ID - with the government saying a digital option will make age-checks quicker and more secure for customers and staff.

Customers will be able to choose ID apps from a range of suppliers such as the Post Office, Yoti or Luciditi, provided they are on a government-approved list.

The change means businesses will no longer be required to let people use physical ID, but the government contends most establishments would.

The plan will be technology-agnostic, meaning that the government is not setting out in detail how each app must work.

It argues that under the voluntary digital ID scheme, drinkers would share fewer personal details with a venue or shop - such as tapping their phone on a reader or displaying a scannable QR code rather than handing over an official document.

The apps will also need to guard against customers borrowing devices from older friends and relatives, and ensure the ID app belongs to the person using it.

Yoti's digital ID app, for example, will only let a user log in if a scan of their face matches that of the person who signed up for the app.

The app then generates a QR code that can be scanned by a business with a free checker app, which tells them the person's age.

Digital government minister Stephanie Peacock said having the option for digital ID would "mean you do not need to carry a physical ID, nor hand over sensitive personal information" meaning people could "feel safer on a night out'".

Allen Simpson, chief executive of trade body UKHospitality, said the new rules were a "positive step".

He added the industry would work with government to make sure the scheme's roll-out would not be "burdensome" for the hospitality sector.

This would include ensuring there were multiple options for suppliers and that it was cost-efficient, Simpson said.

The government wants digital ID apps under its scheme to work together so customers do not need to use different apps in different venues.

It also wants the services to work offline and accessible even without mobile data or a Wi-Fi connection.

In future, the digital proof of age scheme could be extended to cover tobacco and vapes.

But digital rights campaigners have said such measures could lead to the exclusion of some groups.

Jasleen Chaggar of Big Brother Watch said while having multiple ways to prove your identity was helpful, the Government should ensure that digital ID did not become effectively mandatory "as it would shut out millions of people".

"Many people have legitimate reasons for relying on physical ID, whether out of choice, privacy and...
body.zh: 根据周二推出的新规定，酒类购买者将能够使用手机上的数字身份应用程序来证明自己的年龄。 除了当前的实体身份证件之外，英格兰和威尔士的酒吧和商店还可以使用这项技术——政府表示，数字选项将使年龄检查对顾客和员工来说更快、更安全。 客户将能够从 Post Office、Yoti 或 Luciditi 等一系列供应商那里选择 ID 应用程序，前提是它们位于政府批准的列表中。 这一变化意味着企业将不再被要求让人们使用实体身份证，但政府认为大多数企业都会这样做。 该计划将与技术无关，这意味着政府不会详细说明每个应用程序必须如何运行。 它认为，根据自愿数字身份计划，饮酒者将与场所或商店分享更少的个人详细信息，例如将手机放在阅读器上或显示可扫描的二维码，而不是提交官方文件。 这些应用程序还需要防止客户从年长的朋友和亲戚那里借用设备，并确保 ID 应用程序属于使用它的人。 例如，Yoti 的数字身份证应用程序只有在面部​​扫描与注册该应用程序的人的面部扫描相匹配时才会允许用户登录。 然后，该应用程序会生成一个二维码，企业可以使用免费的检查应用程序扫描该二维码，从而得知该人的年龄。 数字政府部长斯蒂芬妮·皮科克表示，选择数字身份证“意味着你不需要携带实体身份证，也不需要交出敏感的个人信息”，这意味着人们可以“在晚上外出时感到更安全”。 贸易机构英国酒店业协会首席执行官艾伦·辛普森表示，新规则是“积极的一步”。 他补充说，该行业将与政府合作，确保该计划的推出不会给酒店业带来“负担”。 辛普森说，这包括确保供应商有多种选择，并且具有成本效益。 政府希望其计划下的数字身份应用程序能够协同工作，这样客户就不需要在不同的场所使用不同的应用程序。 它还希望这些服务能够离线工作，即使没有移动数据或 Wi-Fi 连接也可以访问。 未来，数字年龄证明计划可能会扩展到涵盖烟草和电子烟。 但数字权利活动人士表示，此类措施可能会导致某些群体被排除在外。 Big Brother Watch 的贾斯琳·查加尔 (Jasleen Chaggar) 表示，虽然有多种方法来证明你的身份很有帮助，但政府应该确保数字身份不会成为有效的强制措施，“因为这会将数百万人拒之门外”。 “许多人有合理的理由依赖实体身份证，无论是出于选择、隐私还是......

reflection.en: The introduction of digital ID apps for age verification in England and Wales reflects a shift in how authorities manage and verify information. Romans 13:1 reminds us that governing authorities are established by God, and there is a call to respect and cooperate with these structures, even as they evolve with technology. This change offers a new way for...
reflection.zh: 英格兰和威尔士引入数字身份证应用程序进行年龄验证，反映了政府在管理和验证信息方式上的转变。罗马书13:1提醒我们，执政的权柄是神设立的，我们当尊重并配合这些体制，即使它们随着技术而演变。这一变化为企业和顾客在法律框架内互动提供了一种新方式。

verse.textEn: Let everyone be subject to the governing authorities, for there is no authority except that which God has established.
verse.textZh: 在上有权柄的，人人当顺服他，因为没有权柄不是出于神的。

title.en: Valve's Steam Frame is excellent - but at over £1,000 is VR still too expensive?
title.zh: Valve的Steam Frame表现出色——但超过1000英镑的VR设备是否仍然太贵了？

summary.en: The BBC's Tom Gerken is hands-on with the latest virtual reality headset.
summary.zh: BBC的汤姆·格肯亲身体验了最新的虚拟现实头显。

body.en:
Valve's new virtual reality headset, the Steam Frame, has officially been released - but it comes at a high price.

The hardware is excellent - a light device which feels comfortable to wear and is packed with clever technology - so long as you're willing to pay a whopping £1,089 for a headset with 1TB of storage.

Both are capable of streaming from a PC as well as playing games on-device, with varying degrees of success.

But it carries a price tag which will make a lot of people roll their eyes, and doesn't do much to dispel criticism that increasingly-costly VR headsets are pricing people out of the hobby.

But before we get into that hefty price tag, is the Steam Frame actually any good?

I've owned VR headsets for well over a decade, and Valve's latest effort makes a promising first impression.

Games run well - really the bare minimum considering the price tag - and it's easy enough to use.

One of the nice things is, like Meta's Quest 3, it has flat "pancake" lenses allowing you to see clearly when you put the headset on.

It's light - weighing little more than a can of soup. But what makes it comfortable is the decision to separate the internals up.

The battery pack rests on the back of your head while the screen is at the front - meaning you don't feel front-heavy, a common criticism of other headsets.

But there are better screens out there. The PlayStation VR2 for example has incredible OLED displays, albeit without the pancake lenses.

Yet these come at a serious premium, costing significantly more than the Steam Frame.

When Meta launched the Quest 3 in June 2023, its 128GB model retailed for £480. Less storage, but a much lower price.

Three years later, it's hard to believe VR just keeps getting more expensive when the Quest 3 felt like a turning point.

"VR today is ultimately a high-end niche," gaming writer Christopher Dring told me.

"Meta had been subsidising the Quest hardware, and it's difficult to imagine they will going forward as they pivot away from those experiences."

Of course, there are reasons for prices going up. AI developers are building giant data centres filled with racks of powerful servers, using many of the same components needed to make devices like the Steam Frame.

Ram prices alone more than doubled in price between October 2025 and the start of 2026 . Meanwhile, the graphics card I bought for £500 a few months ago now sits at closer to £650.

As prices climb higher and higher, hardware developers don't have much of a choice but to put up their own.

"We set out to come out with a device that would have been much more affordable," Valve developer Jeremy Selan said.

"But the global Ram market has impacted us the same way it's impacted everybody."

"The idea that it's too expensive is one of the biggest...
body.zh: Valve 的新款虚拟现实耳机 Steam Frame 已正式发布，但价格高昂。 其硬件非常出色，是一款佩戴舒适、采用巧妙技术的轻便设备，只要您愿意花 1,089 英镑购买一款具有 1TB 存储空间的耳机。 两者都能够从 PC 上进行流媒体播放，也能够在设备上玩游戏，并取得了不同程度的成功。 但它的价格标签会让很多人翻白眼，而且并不能消除人们对日益昂贵的虚拟现实头显让人们放弃这项爱好的批评。 但在我们讨论这个高昂的价格之前，Steam Frame 真的好吗？ 我拥有 VR 耳机已有十多年了，Valve 的最新成果给我留下了美好的第一印象。 游戏运行良好——考虑到价格标签，这确实是最低限度——而且它很容易使用。 优点之一是，与 Meta 的 Quest 3 一样，它具有扁平的“煎饼”镜片，让您戴上耳机时可以清晰地看到。 它很轻——只比一罐汤重一点。但让它感到舒适的是决定将内部结构分开。 电池组位于您的后脑勺上，而屏幕位于前面，这意味着您不会感到前部沉重，这是其他耳机常见的批评。 但还有更好的屏幕。例如，PlayStation VR2 拥有令人难以置信的 OLED 显示屏，尽管没有薄饼镜头。 然而，这些产品的溢价非常高，其成本远远高于 Steam Frame。 当 Meta 于 2023 年 6 月推出 Quest 3 时，其 128GB 型号的零售价为 480 英镑。存储空间更少，但价格却低得多。 三年后，当 Quest 3 感觉像是一个转折点时，很难相信 VR 会变得越来越贵。 “今天的虚拟现实最终是一个高端利基市场，”游戏作家克里斯托弗·德林告诉我。 “Meta 一直在补贴 Quest 硬件，很难想象他们会在放弃这些体验时继续前进。” 当然，价格上涨是有原因的。人工智能开发人员正在建造巨大的数据中心，其中充满了强大服务器的机架，使用许多与制造 Steam Frame 等设备所需的相同组件。 从 2025 年 10 月到 2026 年初，仅公羊的价格就上涨了一倍多。与此同时，我几个月前花 500 英镑购买的显卡现在价格接近 650 英镑。 随着价格越来越高，硬件开发商别无选择，只能自己开发。 Valve 开发者杰里米·塞兰 (Jeremy Selan) 表示：“我们打算推出一款价格更加实惠的设备。” “但全球公羊市场对我们的影响就像对每个人的影响一样。” “价格太贵是最大的想法之一......

reflection.en: The Steam Frame headset offers impressive technology, but its steep price of over £1,000 raises questions about accessibility and the potential for advanced technology to become a barrier rather than a bridge. This echoes the story of Babel, where human ambition to reach new heights through unified effort led to confusion and scattering, reminding us that...
reflection.zh: Steam Frame头显提供了令人印象深刻的技术，但其高达1000多英镑的高昂价格引发了关于可及性的问题，以及先进技术可能成为障碍而非桥梁的担忧。这让人联想到巴别塔的故事，人类试图通过统一的努力达到新高度的野心，最终却导致了混乱和分散，提醒我们技术进步必须辅以智慧和对所有人的影响的考量。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」
